programme.title: When I was Your Age
programme.desc: Paul, 10, is a typical little boy. He goes to school, he plays sports, he is secretly in love, he tries to do as little as possible at home, he confuses his parents to get what he wants. And most of all, he would like them to finally understand that he’s not a baby anymore and is old enough to do things ON HIS OWN! Except that... he has a strange gift... or curse... As soon as someone says the words, “When I was your age...” Paul is immediately hurled back to the time when the person he is talking to was 10 years old like he is now. He can shoot back 20, 30...70 years in time! Before mobile phones existed... When boys and girls didn't go to the same school... When there was only one television station... When toilets were at the far end of the yard... In other words, for a boy in 2021: ancient history! So as soon as he hears, “When I was your age,” gasp, gulp, where and when will he land this time? And in what completely crazy situation?

programme.title: When I was Your Age
programme.desc: Paul, 10, is a typical little boy. He goes to school, he plays sports, he is secretly in love, he tries to do as little as possible at home, he confuses his parents to get what he wants. And most of all, he would like them to finally understand that he’s not a baby anymore and is old enough to do things ON HIS OWN! Except that... he has a strange gift... or curse... As soon as someone says the words, “When I was your age...” Paul is immediately hurled back to the time when the person he is talking to was 10 years old like he is now. He can shoot back 20, 30...70 years in time! Before mobile phones existed... When boys and girls didn't go to the same school... When there was only one television station... When toilets were at the far end of the yard... In other words, for a boy in 2021: ancient history! So as soon as he hears, “When I was your age,” gasp, gulp, where and when will he land this time? And in what completely crazy situation?(n)

programme.desc: 映書與Alfred成為情侶，不單為Alfred下廚做飯，平時不願動的她也勉為其難跟Alfred去戶外活動，Alfred卻因職業病及爭論Timo、Hollie的事惹映書生氣…Hollie主動親吻Timo後震驚不認帳，被Timo逮到機會要她作出賠償，過程無非是想令Hollie認清感情，不要逃避。回家途中遇見Manson激動向Timo對質，幾乎大打出手，Hollie不想張揚拖Manson離開，令Timo誤以為Hollie著緊Manson比自己多…原來Manson發現了Hollie當日簽訂的戀愛合約，Hollie跟Manson講清楚對Timo的心情。隔日Hollie參加公司Team Building活動，得悉活動勝出者可跟CEO Timo單獨吃飯，又知Timo當晚會再去相睇，Hollie認清感覺飛奔去向Timo表白.

programme.title: The Club 呈獻: 社內相親
programme.desc: Timo熱戀期的心情無法隱藏 Hollie害怕會被發現，連接聽Timo電話都要遮掩隱藏，Timo雖明白Hollie是為他著想，但始終不是味兒… Alfred替Timo工作卻意外被映書表姐Crystal纏上，出於不想映書誤會隱瞞了一切；Crystal單方面認定Alfred是Mr. Right，還跟映書分享感情事，映書不知那人正是Alfred，還鼓勵Crystal勇往直前爭取所愛。Timo異地出差回來在同事面前邀Hollie共晉晚餐，Hollie正擔心戀情曝光，Timo尊重Hollie感受解釋是之前Hollie贏出Team Building活動後與CEO吃飯的獎勵…Alfred逃避Crystal以致Crystal找上Gofood，爺爺對Timo、Alfred的荒唐行為感憤怒.

programme.title: 玩‧謝我阿婆 第9集 -挑戰阿婆極限 - 烈女不怕死
programme.desc: 今集繼續在 Cancum 主題樂園玩越野車分享二人參與前後的心情與事後感受，Vivian要挑戰阿 bu 個人極限，要畏高既佢玩Zipline… 之後去玩 Skydive，對阿 bu 來說太激，Vivian 代玩，但睇住個孫由三千呎高空跳 Skydive，足以令她驚嚇。刺激過後於 Cancum 體驗夜生活落 Bar 飲酒跳舞，實行兩婆孫不醉無歸.

programme.title: 紅氣球
programme.desc: 次元得知了海洋在旅程中的秘密。海洋得知設計圖被偷，氣憤非常，再與次元因雙方母親而吵架.

programme.title: 逆轉管弦樂團
programme.desc: 全體練習之後，初音與朝陽討論演奏的細節，她很享受兩人獨處的時光。玉響終於迎來與高階的最後決戰，是否會上演令所有人感動的最後一幕呢.

programme.title: 索女 人妻 ichi 烹 第10集 -菜式: 中菜 - 三道菜：煎蓮藕肉餅、酥炸生蠔、粟米魚肚羹
programme.desc: 經過4集的試煉，中菜組的索女人妻迎來終極挑戰。同時處理煎蓮藕肉餅、酥炸生蠔和粟米魚肚羹，兩位女廚神頓時手足無措，甚至煮到精神失常，而工作人員更因此而付上沉重代價…到底兩位索女人妻，能否在終極比拼時力挽狂瀾? 面對金牌司儀強尼、兩性專家陳詠燊，以及熟知二人廚藝的廚師周世韜，潘杰寧和陳潔玲能否在最後上演一場好戲.

programme.title: 3 分鐘熱度
programme.desc: 娛樂資訊節目《3分鐘熱度》是ViuTV一個自家製作，集娛樂圈消息及熱話的精華式娛樂資訊節目，以明快節奏、幽默角度報道本港及海外演藝界最新動態，快而準追蹤娛樂圈消息.

programme.title: 月巴大作戰
programme.desc: 人生有個真正朋友的確好極！一班月巴苦戰半年終於略有所成，搵到青春搵到朋友搵到條腰。月巴們，下次再返嚟，記住唔好成為脂肪怪呀.

programme.title: 半熟男女
programme.desc: 周斌與曾誠的離婚案正式開庭。周斌不斷透過提問來羞辱證人孫涵涵，孫涵涵勇敢地反擊.

programme.title: NBA 盃 -印第安納溜馬 對 克里夫蘭騎士
Bandai 呈獻: 超人奧米加
Bandai 呈獻: 超人奧米加
老友記實用手冊
programme.desc: 生老病死乃必經之路，年華老去亦絕非千瘡百孔，「老」並不代表老態龍鍾，而是歲月每個階段中所帶來的智慧美感。重中之重是如何優雅地老去，不受年齡束縛，散發出專屬自己的魅力。本節目將為觀眾探索本地專為老友記設計的設施和服務，旨在幫助觀眾了解如何在日常生活中照顧自己與家人。廠景將邀請不同的專家及嘉賓，深入剖析如何面對老年生活的各種挑戰，包括健康管理、社交活動及心理支持；同時滲透社區內老人支援服務及生活設施的外景介紹，讓觀眾體驗如何在熟悉的城市中找到適合長者的生活方式.

programme.title: 我想身體健康
programme.desc: 夏天多蚊，一覺唔覺意被咬，隨時病毒上腦？今集主持強尼、米露迪、Ash，搵埋Anjay一齊請教醫生！究竟日本腦炎點解咁可怕，我哋又可以點應對.

programme.title: P1X3L 5G 上位計劃
programme.desc: 第一屆《P1X3L 5G乖寶寶選拔賽》拉開惟幕，八位主持化身「大B」，施展渾身解術，務求取得《香港小B選舉》八位「小B」的歡心，與他們組隊玩遊戲，競逐「乖寶寶」名銜.

programme.title: 手尋藝術
programme.sub-title: 當代水墨畫大師林天行
programme.desc: 今集，我們將拜訪當代水墨畫大師林天行，深入了解其彩墨作品的創作靈感與技藝。他筆下的荷花自成一格，有「天行荷」之稱。他更即席揮毫及教主持，以沒骨畫出荷花的脫俗與意境.

programme.title: 設計新態度
programme.desc: 說起設計，大眾的印象不外乎都是那幾樣：女生們的童年夢想——時裝設計師？抑或是男生們的「另一半」——汽車設計師。然而更多的，可能是來自父母的反對：不穩定？不實際？在我們創作力最旺盛的時候，這團烈火往往輕易就被澆熄。事實上，我們生活的每一處都充斥著設計的身影。你每天早上苦惱的髮型，你途中走過的建築，甚至是路過的一草一木，背後都是設計師精心設計過後呈現的藝術品。設計，絕非遙不可及。本節目將搜尋並拜訪香港本土各行設計師，了解這個行業的日常工作，發掘這方面的就業前景，讓對設計有興趣的年輕人知道更多這個行業的事，了解設計到底是怎麼一回事，在欣賞各種設計的同時，也希望呈現和宣揚本地設計師的創意，堅定每一位有設計夢的觀眾，讓創作的心燃燒下去.

programme.title: 廚神奶奶是你媽
programme.desc: 本集出場有徐加晴和廖麗觀 (Ann)，她們決定一人主理一款菜迎戰，加晴負責的蕃茄炒蛋慘被嫌棄，明顯廚藝功力未到家。而奶奶Ann主理的薑蒜雞翼未知可否挽回分數，成巧晉身下一圈呢？而莊韻澄 (Xenia) 和泰國奶奶鄧心明 (阿碧) 就合作無間，中泰組合出戰似乎相當順利，阿碧炮製的飛天通菜、冬蔭功和生菜包令評判十分驚喜，大讚不絕，這對中泰婆媳組合會否一直狀態大勇.

programme.title: 光之美少女偶像與你
programme.sub-title: 光之美少女！令你閃閃發光

programme.title: 世界之「趣」
programme.desc: 正所謂「世界之大無奇不有」！在這千奇百趣的世界裡，當中集合了許多有趣歷史和文化，不知你又認識幾多呢？就讓「AI導遊」考考你，與大家一起探索世界，成為「世界百科小博士」.

programme.title: 大鳴大放
programme.desc: 《大鳴大放》是一個30分鐘的時事討論節目，識英雄重英雄，請來各界重磅名人，拋出論點，言無不盡，深入討論時事，跨越維港神州，宏觀全世界.

programme.title: 雲端對談 第三系列
programme.desc: 知微見著，而縱觀時局。高維視角，為聆聽眾聲。在複雜多變的時代，如何以創造力融通世界？雲端對談走進南沙，從火箭研發，到自動駕駛，超快充電池，發展灣區醫藥港，展開一場雲端對談.

programme.title: Towngas Mia Cucina呈獻: 磚造美學
programme.desc: 每次住酒店，富麗堂皇嘅裝潢都超吸睛，如果將呢份奢華擺入屋企，點樣可以喺美感同浮誇之間取得平衡？浸浴非常舒服，但未必個個浴室都適合擺浴缸，如果有呢個需求，設計師又可以點解決.(c)

programme.title: 道地星期六影院: 週六好戲勢: 掃毒2天地對決
programme.desc: 本來四分天下的毒品市場，自黑幫「正興」門生地藏與墨西哥大毒梟跨境合作擴展勢力，再加上一連串的黑吃黑，弄得「毒界」風聲鶴唳。另一邊廂，因兒時親睹父親被毒品所毀而疾「毒」如仇的慈善家兼金融鉅子余順天，懸紅一億殲滅香港最大毒販，在社會引起軒然大波。警員林正風本致力搜證拘捕地藏，現因一億懸紅而需要保護人身安全受威脅的毒販，深感無奈的同時，亦被余順天的出價所誘惑，陷入黑白正邪之心理掙扎。原來，余順天和地藏有不可告人的同門關係，一場天地對決勢必爆發.

programme.title: 婚前試行為
programme.desc: 情侶遷入「木屋區」過夜，在狹窄斗室及有限資源下，體驗同住困難；甜蜜溫馨、鼓譟不安、色心大起，更有人不滿製作組安排，令女友大受委屈，打算退出節目.

programme.title: 嫌疑事件簿
programme.desc: 眾人不斷調查誰在房間內鬼混及落毒害溢濠，過程中他們又發現一件事情和他們5人有相關的事情。到底一切的相識是緣份還是早有預謀呢.

programme.title: 一路向西伯利亞
programme.desc: 兩男主持相約學生及兼職模特兒Anna遊覽葉卡捷琳堡。他們先後參觀了沙皇被處決的地點──滴血教堂，以及水壩公園、鍵盤紀念碑和當地食物市場。而Anna其後亦邀請她任職酒保的朋友Valeria同行。四人晚飯後便到酒吧遊玩，期間四人分享香港及俄羅斯酒吧裏常玩的遊戲；最後，兩男主持更為女生度身訂造，調配雞尾酒.

programme.title: 貓之旅神
programme.sub-title: 希林傑村飲酒, 咖啡, 咖啡占卜
programme.desc: 《 貓之旅神》來到最後一集，當然要參觀土耳其著名的聖索菲亞清真寺，Shirley 及Asha為表誠意更特登挑選合適嘅頭巾！接住二人來到有頂大市集，更在大市集上蓋學特務電影007飛檐走壁？！驚慄刺激過後 ，二人就來到了有「最美好的村落」之稱的希林傑村 ，試咖啡占卜，嚐美酒，跟貓一同渡過最悠閒最寫意的旅程.

programme.title: 手作Low Gear
programme.desc: 決賽是比賽的終點，也是決鬥的舞台。勿忘手作的原意是要讓人快樂，五隊車隊今次要製作一部能讓100位嚟自不同階層的市民開心的車，鬥快之餘亦要取得每人手上的一票，成為冠軍車隊.

programme.title: 正一廣東話
programme.desc: 正所謂「民以食為天」，從古至今，對於食物的文字紀錄，可以說是千變萬化。大家除了「識食」，對於食物背後的歷史典故認識有幾多？甚至要用什麼詞彙去形容食物的味道？今集請來衛詩雅（Michelle）、劉若寶（Polly）、岑珈其（珈其）和陳俞希（Hailey）分組玩遊戲，看大家形容食物的認識程度有幾多.

programme.title: 少年談未來
programme.desc: 《少年談未来》是一個屬於青少年尋找職志方向的資訊性清談節目。每一集將會邀請到一位正在努力進修專業課程，或有職業目標的青少年與一位業內專業人士論盡職業當中的一切問題。專業人士除了慷慨解囊，更會帶出工作內容的特點，讓大家了解到真正職場的專業需求和適合的性格。透過本節目，青少年能夠了解到香港各個熱門職業的實戰一面，擺脫對職業的迷思和顧慮，在找到屬於自己的職業之前可以走更少冤枉路.

programme.title: 環保發現號
programme.desc: 回收物料除了可以製成運動衣物，還可以與不同品牌合作，展現更多可能。今集繼續訪問環保時尚運動品牌主理人，看看還有哪些不一樣的東西.

programme.title: 老友記實用手冊
programme.desc: 生老病死乃必經之路，年華老去亦絕非千瘡百孔，「老」並不代表老態龍鍾，而是歲月每個階段中所帶來的智慧美感。重中之重是如何優雅地老去，不受年齡束縛，散發出專屬自己的魅力。本節目將為觀眾探索本地專為老友記設計的設施和服務，旨在幫助觀眾了解如何在日常生活中照顧自己與家人。廠景將邀請不同的專家及嘉賓，深入剖析如何面對老年生活的各種挑戰，包括健康管理、社交活動及心理支持；同時滲透社區內老人支援服務及生活設施的外景介紹，讓觀眾體驗如何在熟悉的城市中找到適合長者的生活方式.

programme.title: 廚神奶奶是你媽
programme.desc: 本集出場有徐加晴和廖麗觀 (Ann)，她們決定一人主理一款菜迎戰，加晴負責的蕃茄炒蛋慘被嫌棄，明顯廚藝功力未到家。而奶奶Ann主理的薑蒜雞翼未知可否挽回分數，成巧晉身下一圈呢？而莊韻澄 (Xenia) 和泰國奶奶鄧心明 (阿碧) 就合作無間，中泰組合出戰似乎相當順利，阿碧炮製的飛天通菜、冬蔭功和生菜包令評判十分驚喜，大讚不絕，這對中泰婆媳組合會否一直狀態大勇.

programme.title: 估你唔到 -職業
programme.desc: 今集郭偉亮（Eric Kwok）和劉美君繼續猜四位美女的職業。四位美女會變身成為俏空姐服侍嘉賓，更要幫嘉賓扣安全帶和提供餐飲！不過皇帝式享受的背後，她們竟然打翻托盤上的飲品，說話更粗聲粗氣，令到Eric Kwok既享受但尷尬！究竟四位美女當中有沒有真空姐呢.

programme.title: 夕陽新丁
programme.desc: 幾元一個的雞仔餅、皮蛋酥、角仔是不少港人的共同回憶。但在寸金尺土的香港，傳統餅店難敵昂貴租金，熟悉的咸甜味道日漸消逝。鬼妹仔 Asha 不是吃唐餅長大，卻在深水埗傳統餅店的最後時光，跟師傅們學習搓餅包餡，一起探索這份傳統味道背後的故事.

programme.title: 健康識唔sick
programme.desc: 長期咳嗽，持續疲勞，不良飲食習慣，呢啲都係都市常見現象，但千祈唔好睇小，隨時係癌症先兆！\n隨着癌症有年輕化趨勢，大家應該多關注身體小毛病，年年驗身，就算不幸確診癌症，亦可及早發現，對症下藥。\n本節目會為大家探討本港常見癌症，並邀請專科醫生為大家講解最新癌症治療方法.

programme.title: Bandai 呈獻: No.1戰隊五獸者
programme.sub-title: 秘密採訪！遠野吠是新員工

programme.title: 學界Create, Like and Share 第三季
programme.desc: 全新充滿創意與活力的節目《學界Create, Like and Share》， 帶領觀眾深入探索香港各大學校的獨特魅力和多彩生活! 節目不僅聚焦學校的學術成就，更展現學生們的創意才華與日常趣事，讓觀眾感受到校園的創意與活力。每集節目中，校園導遊瑪姬邀請不同學校的學生團隊，展示他們的創意項目、藝術表演及社會服務，令觀眾更加了解學校！你可以透過這個節目一探學校的多樣性，發掘你未曾想過學校的有趣一面.

programme.title: 辣王傳
programme.desc: 食過不同國家的辣，香港的辣又是如何的？ Isabella、浩南及 Dee 先去街市找不同的辣椒，再去農場找本土種植的辣椒，嘗試找出屬於香港的辣。最後去食港式車仔麵，加上辣椒醬及辣菜脯的車仔麵，會不會就是香港人最熟悉的辣味.

programme.title: Bandai 呈獻: 幪面超人 ZEZTZ
聲畫合拍 8
programme.desc: 《方法演技》講述演員高俊參演學生電影拍攝，卻因表演不到位而陷入困境。面對劇組人員離場的壓力，他提出以極端的方法演技來完成拍攝⋯⋯本集邀請到編導與演員分享拍攝趣事.

programme.title: 深宵更 -點心
programme.desc: 芯駖今集到點心店擔任見習點心師父一職，由了解廚房運作、到學習入門基本工「揦嘢」、包燒賣、以至到「火位」負責蒸製點心，學問逐步遞升。過程中，芯駖不但學到點心製作技巧，更領略到成功竅門——「功多藝熟」.

programme.title: STEM By You
programme.desc: 每天早上來一杯「醒神啡」，是不少都市人的生活習慣。你知道在不同時間喝咖啡，也有不同效果嗎？為甚麼有時會覺得它毫無幫助呢？咖啡可讓人提神，背後藏著甚麼科學秘密.

programme.title: 搵食考快Cert.
programme.desc: 經歷完上集一連兩張cert嘅失敗，今次就輪到Dixon 表演啦，Dixon 竟然搵到張可以用2日時間嘅課程！到底係咩課程可以咁快攞到張cert咁吸引呢.

programme.title: 35+ LOVE
programme.sub-title: 阿Yu坦開心扉/ Aka陷入苦惱
programme.desc: 趙頌茹（Yu）再次進行四小時階段約會，而在看畢這次約會過程後，戀愛觀察員陳柏宇（Jason）大讚阿Yu和這位男參加者有著意料之外的火花，到底是哪位男士可以成功令阿Yu坦開心扉？趙慧珊（Aka）在四小時階段選擇了和區顯揚（Austin）、徐灝晴（Hugo）及 李坤潮（Jason）繼續約會，面對3男的猛烈攻勢陷入苦惱，節目組邀請了她的多年好友為Aka作出分析，到底好友會如何評價這三位男士？而Jason安排的約會活動，又能否討得Aka的歡心.

programme.title: 恐怖醫學
programme.desc: 用情境劇來表現一些病症的發生，一些大家很少留意的症狀，但可能是某種嚴重疾病的先兆。再請該疾病領域的醫師，進行解說及分析，說明情境劇內發生的事情，可能已經在實際生活中發生了，並教觀眾如何做簡單的自我檢測，內容沒有艱深的醫學報導，戲劇表現生活化.

programme.title: 貓之旅神
programme.sub-title: 希林傑村飲酒, 咖啡, 咖啡占卜
programme.desc: 《 貓之旅神》來到最後一集，當然要參觀土耳其著名的聖索菲亞清真寺，Shirley 及Asha為表誠意更特登挑選合適嘅頭巾！接住二人來到有頂大市集，更在大市集上蓋學特務電影007飛檐走壁？！驚慄刺激過後 ，二人就來到了有「最美好的村落」之稱的希林傑村 ，試咖啡占卜，嚐美酒，跟貓一同渡過最悠閒最寫意的旅程.

programme.title: 大鳴大放
programme.desc: 《大鳴大放》是一個30分鐘的時事討論節目，識英雄重英雄，請來各界重磅名人，拋出論點，言無不盡，深入討論時事，跨越維港神州，宏觀全世界.

programme.title: 經緯線
programme.desc: 專題式深入報道香港及世界熱門時事.

programme.title: Gen Z觀察學
programme.desc: Gen Z這詞至今應該並不陌生，這一代在智能手機面世後才出生的這群年輕人在龐大網絡資訊量的環境下成長，會否變得實際不再愛做夢？還是更愛活在自己世界裏，只沉醉於自己的夢？更重要的是，他們的夢，究竟是什麼？將來的世界是屬於他們的，他們又如何看待這個世界？如何用他們的長處來幫到自己、幫到他人、甚至幫到這個世界？世界對他們許多的標籤，有讚許的，但更多是質疑，究竟當中幾多成真幾成是偏見？ 社會卻很愛輕易地一句：「代溝」就形容了兩代關係，但其實connect 可以來得很輕易。今次節目主旨就是一部將觀眾嘅價值觀由上一代穿越到這一代的時光機，由Gen X代表強尼、Gen Y代表練美娟同Gen Z代表 Boris 來一個三代同堂，帶大家進入00後腦洞大開的世界，了解新世代的價值觀，並將這些00後進行有趣的大配對，發揮他們的強項，幫助自己、幫助對方，以及幫助更多的人。跟大家一起上一堂《GenZ觀察學》.

programme.title: DrGo One Wellness呈獻: 我想身體健康
programme.desc: 醫學昌明，癌症已經有好多應對方法。不過如果生喺腦度，我哋係咪都係束手無策？今集主持強尼、米露迪、Ash，搵埋KylieC.一齊請教醫生！究竟呢個咁可怕嘅癌症，醫學界會唔會有新突破.

programme.title: FWD 富衛保險呈獻: CHILL CLUB
programme.desc: 本集《CHILL CLUB》邀請到Pandora，以「成長的綻放」為主題，演唱多首代表樂隊一路以來成長路上的經歷。Pandora更帶來演唱會主題Medley，與樂迷一同成為綻放的花朵！本集亦邀請到何雁詩帶來歌曲《黑房》，樂迷切勿錯過！本集亦會有「CHILL CLUB推介榜」，與樂迷公布本周第一至十位推介歌曲.

programme.title: 蠟筆小新
programme.desc: 臼井儀人漫畫作品。五歲小孩野原新之助（小新）百厭趣怪，個性誇張自戀，是最令人頭痛的小朋友。小新與父親廣志、母親美冴、妹妹小葵住在埼玉縣的春日部市，最愛領著「雙葉幼稚園」的朋友你搞冒險，在日常生活中製造無數瘋狂趣事.

programme.title: 戀愛Staycation
programme.desc: 來到第一次約會，由女生作主導邀約心儀男生，難得今次不再抽籤可以自己做選擇，究竟她們會邀約早前命運之神安排的對象作進一步認識？還是作新嘗試邀約新的男生？4男4女的局面下，究竟這次還會出現三角關係嗎？會否有人沒有人約呢？幾組人的約會氛圍分別是怎樣.

programme.title: 沖繩任你點
programme.desc: 先行到埗的Tsoul，肩負起重要任務，就是充當自駕遊司機，久未駕駛的他，當然需要接受一連串額外特訓，同時要接受由網民任你點的挑戰。在特訓的過程中， Tsoul駕駛險象環生，究竟他能否完成訓練？而其他成員到埗後會滿意他的表現嗎.

programme.title: 學神出沒注意
programme.sub-title: 當P牌女神遇上強尼導師
programme.desc: 今集《學神出沒注意》P牌女神孤軍作戰了幾集，今集終於為她安排了強尼為她特訓，強尼除了教嘉倩一些揸車換軚的知識之外，當然要來一個大考驗，看看嘉倩有沒有進步！二人一來就挑戰塞車的最高境界，由觀塘的駿業里駛到屯門公路，強尼更準備了塞車五寶，準備好齊齊塞到天荒地老！高手在民間，接著強尼更帶嘉倩認識一眾JDM車主以及他們的愛車，了解何謂男人的浪漫.

programme.title: 手尋藝術
programme.sub-title: 當代水墨畫大師林天行
programme.desc: 今集，我們將拜訪當代水墨畫大師林天行，深入了解其彩墨作品的創作靈感與技藝。他筆下的荷花自成一格，有「天行荷」之稱。他更即席揮毫及教主持，以沒骨畫出荷花的脫俗與意境.

programme.title: 夕陽新丁
programme.desc: 幾元一個的雞仔餅、皮蛋酥、角仔是不少港人的共同回憶。但在寸金尺土的香港，傳統餅店難敵昂貴租金，熟悉的咸甜味道日漸消逝。鬼妹仔 Asha 不是吃唐餅長大，卻在深水埗傳統餅店的最後時光，跟師傅們學習搓餅包餡，一起探索這份傳統味道背後的故事.

programme.title: 辣王傳
programme.desc: 食過不同國家的辣，香港的辣又是如何的？ Isabella、浩南及 Dee 先去街市找不同的辣椒，再去農場找本土種植的辣椒，嘗試找出屬於香港的辣。最後去食港式車仔麵，加上辣椒醬及辣菜脯的車仔麵，會不會就是香港人最熟悉的辣味.

programme.title: 設計新態度
programme.desc: 說起設計，大眾的印象不外乎都是那幾樣：女生們的童年夢想——時裝設計師？抑或是男生們的「另一半」——汽車設計師。然而更多的，可能是來自父母的反對：不穩定？不實際？在我們創作力最旺盛的時候，這團烈火往往輕易就被澆熄。事實上，我們生活的每一處都充斥著設計的身影。你每天早上苦惱的髮型，你途中走過的建築，甚至是路過的一草一木，背後都是設計師精心設計過後呈現的藝術品。設計，絕非遙不可及。本節目將搜尋並拜訪香港本土各行設計師，了解這個行業的日常工作，發掘這方面的就業前景，讓對設計有興趣的年輕人知道更多這個行業的事，了解設計到底是怎麼一回事，在欣賞各種設計的同時，也希望呈現和宣揚本地設計師的創意，堅定每一位有設計夢的觀眾，讓創作的心燃燒下去.

programme.title: 少年談未來
programme.desc: 《少年談未来》是一個屬於青少年尋找職志方向的資訊性清談節目。每一集將會邀請到一位正在努力進修專業課程，或有職業目標的青少年與一位業內專業人士論盡職業當中的一切問題。專業人士除了慷慨解囊，更會帶出工作內容的特點，讓大家了解到真正職場的專業需求和適合的性格。透過本節目，青少年能夠了解到香港各個熱門職業的實戰一面，擺脫對職業的迷思和顧慮，在找到屬於自己的職業之前可以走更少冤枉路.

programme.title: 全運港將
programme.desc: 四年一度的「全運會」，今年踏入第十五屆，將於2025年11月9號至21號，在廣東、香港和澳門三地舉行，全國各地的頂尖運動員將會雲集粵港澳三地，競逐各項賽事的殊榮。我地每一集都會介紹唔同項目的香港運動員代表，了解佢地平時的訓練，同埋備戰全運會的最新情況，一齊為全運港將打氣.

The Club呈獻: 晚吹 - 男人亂講嘢
programme.desc: 世界覺醒（WOKE）了，每天都變得更像彩虹更有活力！從來以為自己是世界中心的男人卻呆站原地，眼光光看著日換星移宇宙萬變，看似固步自封但其實是有心無力！為舒緩廣大香港男士因為社會價值急速變化產生的焦慮和不安，三字頭的193（郭嘉駿）、四字頭的阿Thor（駱振偉）、以及五字頭的灘叔（鄒凱光）每星期都會圍爐亂講一通︰講男人求偶、男人私怨、男人包袱、男人浪漫、男人衰嘢、男人保健、男人蠢事——女觀眾或會恥笑，但男觀眾一定會感動大笑！就此召喚迷途的新時代男性，同《男人亂講嘢》一齊尋找當下世界觀，刷新固有價值觀，重塑男人三十、四十、五十路的人生觀！今次唔係要話人知男人曾經有幾威，而係要探討宜家男人有幾閉翳.(n)

programme.title: The Club 呈獻: 社內相親
programme.desc: Hollie與Timo的戀情避過父母耳目，卻被弟弟Homan發現，Homan初次見面已叫Timo做姐夫，令Timo十分喜歡。Manson女友阿敏找上Hollie，請Hollie遠離Manson，Hollie始知Manson對她生了情愫。Hollie跟Manson說清楚，Manson勸說Hollie跟Timo不會有結果，但Hollie還是想努力嘗試一下…Hollie邀請Timo下班好好約會，沒想到約會天下雨，Hollie知Timo懼怕雨天，無所不用其極避免在雨天待在戶外，貼心舉動讓Timo更認定Hollie是另一半。約會後爺爺約Hollie單獨見面，爺爺知二人戀情要她離開Timo，Hollie瞞著Timo見爺爺被Timo發現，因而發生了一場意外，爺爺看到小情侶互相著緊似有動搖…Timo終向Hollie道出為何自己會對雨天感驚恐.(n)

programme.title: 旅巫
programme.desc: 世上，有一群人信奉萬物皆有靈，熟知遠古流傳下來的療癒技巧，並使用這些技巧療癒自己和族人。在部落中代表著「知識」，「力量」和「療癒」，他們被尊稱為「薩滿」。但到底薩滿的治療加量是古代智慧的結晶，抑底是文明落後的鐵證？為了解開迷團，Yoshi與Kanya決定出發前往地球的另一端的南美洲秘魯，尋找薩滿，發掘真相。這趟旅程，會如想像之中順利嗎.(n)

programme.title: 艾娜星際探秘
programme.sub-title: 太空奇遇 / 失控的月球車
programme.desc: 3021 年，在銀河系火星和木星之間的某個太空站上，8 歲的艾拉.懷達與她的朋友們一起踏上了激動人心的探索之旅。而且因為她們在太空中，所以有很多東西可以體驗，甚至有更多東西可以探索！艾拉的冒險不僅充滿刺激和樂趣，也總是充滿情感，讓她在每次意想不到的挑戰中發現並更加了解自己——她就跟她的名字一樣獨特：星際艾拉.(n)

programme.title: 設計新態度
programme.desc: 說起設計，大眾的印象不外乎都是那幾樣：女生們的童年夢想——時裝設計師？抑或是男生們的「另一半」——汽車設計師。然而更多的，可能是來自父母的反對：不穩定？不實際？在我們創作力最旺盛的時候，這團烈火往往輕易就被澆熄。事實上，我們生活的每一處都充斥著設計的身影。你每天早上苦惱的髮型，你途中走過的建築，甚至是路過的一草一木，背後都是設計師精心設計過後呈現的藝術品。設計，絕非遙不可及。本節目將搜尋並拜訪香港本土各行設計師，了解這個行業的日常工作，發掘這方面的就業前景，讓對設計有興趣的年輕人知道更多這個行業的事，了解設計到底是怎麼一回事，在欣賞各種設計的同時，也希望呈現和宣揚本地設計師的創意，堅定每一位有設計夢的觀眾，讓創作的心燃燒下去.(n)

programme.desc: 生活總會遇上大小煩惱及奇怪遭遇，無論來自事業、家庭、愛情、朋友、自身，無論發生在工作環境、家居、街道、商場、食肆 … … 總有林林總總，各式奇式的事情讓你困擾尷尬、不吐不快、睇唔過眼、不便開口、想搵人傾吓笑吓，或者尋求建議指引…遇到疑難，不懂抉擇；奇趣遭遇，想開心share，歡迎留言及來信本節目，見過風浪、閱人無數，走遍劇場及大小螢幕的都會女主持彭秀慧（KP），會聯同現場觀眾或與知名嘉賓互動，以開信形式，甚至即場phone in，同大家一齊拆解研究，為大家提供建議、指引或心靈輔導，助你一解心扉，一齊一笑解千愁.(n)

programme.title: The Club 呈獻: 社內相親
programme.desc: Alfred接到映書爸爸的電話，要求他與映書分手，映書對父親失望，決定辭職，徹底與父親斷絕關係。Timo也到Hollie家與Hollie爸媽說明彼此的關係，希望能獲得認可，Hollie爸爸坦言Hollie因為父母吃盡苦頭，希望Timo不會讓她受到傷害。爺爺為了逼Timo分手再度假裝生病，然而檢查過程卻被發現心臟出現問題，必須到美國才能接受治療，Timo想帶Hollie一起出國，但Hollie決定留下，兩人因此開始了為期1年的異地戀。1年後，映書自創、Alfred投資的公司已經步上軌道。Hollie跟Timo卻只能靠視訊聯繫感情，惴惴不安的Hollie決定到紐約找Timo，卻遇到令她意外不已的事情.(n)

programme.title: 全領域異常解決室

programme.desc: 講述春田、黒澤、牧三人在《大叔的愛》五年後，跨越了疫情的生活。而社會上對性別多元亦有更大的接受程度，男同性戀情更被大眾認同下，這三人能否過著更幸福的生活呢.

programme.title: 全領域異常解決室
programme.desc: 在最重視了解自然災害和吉凶的日本有著世界上最古老的調查機構「全領域異常解決辦公室」以解決難以想像的「無法解釋的異常案件」。但似乎隱藏著一個巨大的秘密. .....人們面對的「異常事件」，例如無法用科學解釋的超自然現象。這是一個可能真實發生在你身邊的故事。甚麼是真實的，甚麼是虛構的？ 真相在下一刻就變成了妄想.

programme.title: 日本第一的爛男人-我的假家人們
programme.desc: 主角大森一平（香取慎吾）是人生被逼到懸崖邊的前播報員，被家人和孩子討壓的最爛男人，為了選舉，和單親爸爸的妹夫及其孩子們一起生活。在面對日常生活中的家庭和社會問題的過程中，最差勁的男人一邊和妹夫和孩子們一點一點地建立起真正的家庭關係，一邊希望逐漸建立更好的社會，不久後努力參加選舉….

programme.title: 大奧
programme.desc: 在江戶時代中期，經濟持續惡化，日本國民每天都被迫過著樸素、節儉、勤勞的生活。百姓們等待著一位能夠改善經濟現狀、使國家和百姓富裕起來的將軍出現。在這樣的背景下，五十宮倫子被迫與德川幕府第十代幕府將軍德川家治進行政治婚姻，從京都前往位於江戶城中心區的大奧，那裡有近千名侍奉將軍的女性。為了贏得將軍的寵愛，此刻，女人們的鬥爭即將拉開帷幕。另一方面，有人正在策劃陰謀，企圖將大奧與江戶幕府拉入混亂的旋渦當中.

programme.desc: 在江戶時代中期，經濟持續惡化，日本國民每天都被迫過著樸素、節儉、勤勞的生活。百姓們等待著一位能夠改善經濟現狀、使國家和百姓富裕起來的將軍出現。在這樣的背景下，五十宮倫子被迫與德川幕府第十代幕府將軍德川家治進行政治婚姻，從京都前往位於江戶城中心區的大奧，那裡有近千名侍奉將軍的女性。為了贏得將軍的寵愛，此刻，女人們的鬥爭即將拉開帷幕。另一方面，有人正在策劃陰謀，企圖將大奧與江戶幕府拉入混亂的旋渦當中.

programme.title: 日本第一的爛男人-我的假家人們
programme.desc: 主角大森一平（香取慎吾）是人生被逼到懸崖邊的前播報員，被家人和孩子討壓的最爛男人，為了選舉，和單親爸爸的妹夫及其孩子們一起生活。在面對日常生活中的家庭和社會問題的過程中，最差勁的男人一邊和妹夫和孩子們一點一點地建立起真正的家庭關係，一邊希望逐漸建立更好的社會，不久後努力參加選舉….

programme.desc: 劇集講述傳承三代、釀造傳統酒的釀酒廠「老鷹酒都家」中，個性十足的五兄弟，和才結婚十天就成為寡婦兼一家之主的大嫂之間，有著他們獨特配方的家庭故事 。​.(n)

programme.title: 勞務師盧武鎮
programme.desc: 講述只為生活奔波、毫無歷史或社會意識的生存型勞務師「盧武鎮」，為了支付辦公室租金在各個勞動現場奔波解決勞動問題，四處碰壁。「盧武鎮」卻會在生死一線間倖存下來，歷經波折的奇幻鬧劇.(n)

programme.title: 拜託戒酒吧

programme.title: 清潭國際高等學校
programme.desc: 出身貧困家庭的高中生慧仁巧合地成為一宗校園謀殺案的唯一目擊者。她其後便獲得了著名的清潭國際高等學校的全額獎學金，那是一所富裕而且具有影響力的貴族學校。然而，這一機遇也伴隨著一系列挑戰。在清潭國際高等學校，慧仁遇到了白齊娜——學校裡最有權勢的學生，她亦恰好是謀殺案的主要嫌疑人.(n)

programme.title: 盜賊：七個朝鮮通寶
programme.desc: 講述神秘的文化遺產盜賊「臭鼬」與非正式的文化遺產回收組「Karma」展開合作，對法律無法審判的人進行懲治的故事.(n)

programme.title: 才不要和老闆談戀愛
programme.desc: 《才不要和老闆談戀愛》改編自葉斐然的同名小説，講述了陸詢的員工錢唯在28歲事業受阻時陰差陽錯回到18歲，重新遇上老闆，從職場跨越到校園，再重新迴歸職場，一路高歌猛進，追求事業愛情雙豐收的成長故事.

programme.title: 長歌行
programme.desc: 大唐，玄武門之變後，太子李建成及其黨羽被誅。其女李長歌(迪麗熱巴)憑高超武藝逃出宮，並在追捕過程中制造「墮崖假死」而逃生，女扮男裝隱瞞身份流落民間，一心伺機誅殺李世民為父母復仇。在與突厥特勒阿史那隼(吳磊)一役中，長歌為保朔州百姓而與阿史那隼談判，自願為虜。在被阿史那隼帶往突厥後，長歌用智慧和謀略為阿史那隼解決部落紛爭，從奴隸變為幕僚。在和阿史那隼的相處過程中，長歌被這個勇猛無匹、重情重義的異族青年所吸引，兩人傾心相戀，譜寫了一曲跨越民族和文化的愛情戀歌.

programme.title: 花琉璃軼聞
programme.desc: 大晉昌隆年間，剛剛大勝金珀國立下赫赫戰功的護國大將軍花應庭，將掌上明珠唯一的女兒花琉璃先送返京城。自小隨父兄在邊關軍營長大的花琉璃雖是女兒身，但天資聰穎，更習得一身好武藝。然而京城不同於邊關，一方面，花家擁兵自重的謠言甚囂塵上，另一方面，二皇子姬元溯以非長子身份被冊封為太子，又偏不務正業，本已引人側目。本以為走入了風暴眼的花琉璃，卻完全不按套路出牌，一路扮豬吃虎，將人設拗成了病嬌之態，憑藉一己之力手撕名媛圈，更讓太子和金珀皇子拜倒在石榴裙下，硬生生將奪嫡加權謀的大戲劇本改成了一出人間沙雕甜愛劇.

programme.title: 以美之名
programme.desc: 師出同門的整形外科醫生喬楊和周靜雯是多年冤家，兩個女人在各自最糗的時刻迎來宿命般重逢，同為整形醫院的王牌醫生，二人帶領各自團隊，展開關於美、關於女性職場、關於醫者仁心的激烈探討與衝撞。直到更大的敵人出現，兩人克服對彼此的偏見聯手，與極度危險的黑醫美勢力對抗，找回屬於醫生的高光、亦成就更美的自己.

programme.title: 才不要和老闆談戀愛

programme.title: 餘生，請多指教
programme.desc: 《餘生，請多指教》改編自柏林石匠同名小說，講述了音樂系大三學生林之校因父親生病住院，與父親的主刀醫生顧魏邂逅並相愛的故事.

programme.desc: 師出同門的整形外科醫生喬楊和周靜雯是多年冤家，兩個女人在各自最糗的時刻迎來宿命般重逢，同為整形醫院的王牌醫生，二人帶領各自團隊，展開關於美、關於女性職場、關於醫者仁心的激烈探討與衝撞。直到更大的敵人出現，兩人克服對彼此的偏見聯手，與極度危險的黑醫美勢力對抗，找回屬於醫生的高光、亦成就更美的自己.

programme.title: 才不要和老闆談戀愛
programme.desc: 《才不要和老闆談戀愛》改編自葉斐然的同名小説，講述了陸詢的員工錢唯在28歲事業受阻時陰差陽錯回到18歲，重新遇上老闆，從職場跨越到校園，再重新迴歸職場，一路高歌猛進，追求事業愛情雙豐收的成長故事.

programme.title: 長歌行
programme.desc: 大唐，玄武門之變後，太子李建成及其黨羽被誅。其女李長歌(迪麗熱巴)憑高超武藝逃出宮，並在追捕過程中制造「墮崖假死」而逃生，女扮男裝隱瞞身份流落民間，一心伺機誅殺李世民為父母復仇。在與突厥特勒阿史那隼(吳磊)一役中，長歌為保朔州百姓而與阿史那隼談判，自願為虜。在被阿史那隼帶往突厥後，長歌用智慧和謀略為阿史那隼解決部落紛爭，從奴隸變為幕僚。在和阿史那隼的相處過程中，長歌被這個勇猛無匹、重情重義的異族青年所吸引，兩人傾心相戀，譜寫了一曲跨越民族和文化的愛情戀歌.

programme.desc: 一起下水道的兇案，讓刑警隊長徐驍和老刑警林國強碰到一起，兩人探案手法風格迥異，但因為對真相和正義的共同追求，逐漸彌合了觀點上的分歧，結成亦師亦友的老少搭檔。在破案的過程中並不順利，在考古學家陳楠的幫助下，他們發現作案的兇手有著某種邪惡的思想，兇手難覓食、迷霧難驅，他們雖分歧不斷，但仍朝著一致的目標傾力探尋。最終使兇手伏法.

programme.title: 以美之名
programme.desc: 師出同門的整形外科醫生喬楊和周靜雯是多年冤家，兩個女人在各自最糗的時刻迎來宿命般重逢，同為整形醫院的王牌醫生，二人帶領各自團隊，展開關於美、關於女性職場、關於醫者仁心的激烈探討與衝撞。直到更大的敵人出現，兩人克服對彼此的偏見聯手，與極度危險的黑醫美勢力對抗，找回屬於醫生的高光、亦成就更美的自己.

programme.title: 沒有工作的一年

programme.title: 花琉璃軼聞
programme.desc: 大晉昌隆年間，剛剛大勝金珀國立下赫赫戰功的護國大將軍花應庭，將掌上明珠唯一的女兒花琉璃先送返京城。自小隨父兄在邊關軍營長大的花琉璃雖是女兒身，但天資聰穎，更習得一身好武藝。然而京城不同於邊關，一方面，花家擁兵自重的謠言甚囂塵上，另一方面，二皇子姬元溯以非長子身份被冊封為太子，又偏不務正業，本已引人側目。本以為走入了風暴眼的花琉璃，卻完全不按套路出牌，一路扮豬吃虎，將人設拗成了病嬌之態，憑藉一己之力手撕名媛圈，更讓太子和金珀皇子拜倒在石榴裙下，硬生生將奪嫡加權謀的大戲劇本改成了一出人間沙雕甜愛劇.

programme.title: 誰是兇手
programme.desc: 《誰是兇手》講述了一起發生在海舟市的連環兇案，在真相塵封了十七年之後，與這宗懸案有著千絲萬縷聯繫的人們，在各自不可告人的秘密中，一起等待真相浮出水面的故事。 2001年寒冬，海舟市印刷廠家屬院發生了一起命案。新人刑警冷小兵和師兄接到一起報案奔赴現場，卻意外面對海舟市連環殺人案的兇手。冷小兵膽怯不敢開槍，兇手從現場逃走並殺害了師兄李嵐。現場另一名目擊證人是躲在床下的夏木。為繼續留在警隊冷小兵隱瞞了不敢開槍的事，夏木也沒有揭穿他。至此兇手藏匿起來，海舟案懸而未決。十七年後，夏木來到警隊實習，以冷小兵不敢開槍的事作為把柄，要挾他和自己一起查案。而伴随着神秘的心理医生沈雨的出现，一起几乎与十七年前一模一样的案子再次发生，而沈雨身上一个又一个疑团频频出现，凶手究竟是谁.

programme.title: 新生
programme.desc: 何珊被邀請到一座封閉的小島參加費可的追思會，她在那裡遇到四個互不相識的陌生人，他們被困在地下室里要求說出與費可相識的過程，然而他們發現每個人認識的費可都不一樣.

programme.desc: 大晉昌隆年間，剛剛大勝金珀國立下赫赫戰功的護國大將軍花應庭，將掌上明珠唯一的女兒花琉璃先送返京城。自小隨父兄在邊關軍營長大的花琉璃雖是女兒身，但天資聰穎，更習得一身好武藝。然而京城不同於邊關，一方面，花家擁兵自重的謠言甚囂塵上，另一方面，二皇子姬元溯以非長子身份被冊封為太子，又偏不務正業，本已引人側目。本以為走入了風暴眼的花琉璃，卻完全不按套路出牌，一路扮豬吃虎，將人設拗成了病嬌之態，憑藉一己之力手撕名媛圈，更讓太子和金珀皇子拜倒在石榴裙下，硬生生將奪嫡加權謀的大戲劇本改成了一出人間沙雕甜愛劇.

programme.title: 誰是兇手
programme.desc: 《誰是兇手》講述了一起發生在海舟市的連環兇案，在真相塵封了十七年之後，與這宗懸案有著千絲萬縷聯繫的人們，在各自不可告人的秘密中，一起等待真相浮出水面的故事。 2001年寒冬，海舟市印刷廠家屬院發生了一起命案。新人刑警冷小兵和師兄接到一起報案奔赴現場，卻意外面對海舟市連環殺人案的兇手。冷小兵膽怯不敢開槍，兇手從現場逃走並殺害了師兄李嵐。現場另一名目擊證人是躲在床下的夏木。為繼續留在警隊冷小兵隱瞞了不敢開槍的事，夏木也沒有揭穿他。至此兇手藏匿起來，海舟案懸而未決。十七年後，夏木來到警隊實習，以冷小兵不敢開槍的事作為把柄，要挾他和自己一起查案。而伴随着神秘的心理医生沈雨的出现，一起几乎与十七年前一模一样的案子再次发生，而沈雨身上一个又一个疑团频频出现，凶手究竟是谁.

programme.title: 新生
programme.desc: 何珊被邀請到一座封閉的小島參加費可的追思會，她在那裡遇到四個互不相識的陌生人，他們被困在地下室里要求說出與費可相識的過程，然而他們發現每個人認識的費可都不一樣.

programme.desc: 一起下水道的兇案，讓刑警隊長徐驍和老刑警林國強碰到一起，兩人探案手法風格迥異，但因為對真相和正義的共同追求，逐漸彌合了觀點上的分歧，結成亦師亦友的老少搭檔。在破案的過程中並不順利，在考古學家陳楠的幫助下，他們發現作案的兇手有著某種邪惡的思想，兇手難覓食、迷霧難驅，他們雖分歧不斷，但仍朝著一致的目標傾力探尋。最終使兇手伏法.

programme.title: 以美之名
programme.desc: 師出同門的整形外科醫生喬楊和周靜雯是多年冤家，兩個女人在各自最糗的時刻迎來宿命般重逢，同為整形醫院的王牌醫生，二人帶領各自團隊，展開關於美、關於女性職場、關於醫者仁心的激烈探討與衝撞。直到更大的敵人出現，兩人克服對彼此的偏見聯手，與極度危險的黑醫美勢力對抗，找回屬於醫生的高光、亦成就更美的自己.

programme.desc: 大唐，玄武門之變後，太子李建成及其黨羽被誅。其女李長歌(迪麗熱巴)憑高超武藝逃出宮，並在追捕過程中制造「墮崖假死」而逃生，女扮男裝隱瞞身份流落民間，一心伺機誅殺李世民為父母復仇。在與突厥特勒阿史那隼(吳磊)一役中，長歌為保朔州百姓而與阿史那隼談判，自願為虜。在被阿史那隼帶往突厥後，長歌用智慧和謀略為阿史那隼解決部落紛爭，從奴隸變為幕僚。在和阿史那隼的相處過程中，長歌被這個勇猛無匹、重情重義的異族青年所吸引，兩人傾心相戀，譜寫了一曲跨越民族和文化的愛情戀歌.

programme.title: 花琉璃軼聞
programme.desc: 大晉昌隆年間，剛剛大勝金珀國立下赫赫戰功的護國大將軍花應庭，將掌上明珠唯一的女兒花琉璃先送返京城。自小隨父兄在邊關軍營長大的花琉璃雖是女兒身，但天資聰穎，更習得一身好武藝。然而京城不同於邊關，一方面，花家擁兵自重的謠言甚囂塵上，另一方面，二皇子姬元溯以非長子身份被冊封為太子，又偏不務正業，本已引人側目。本以為走入了風暴眼的花琉璃，卻完全不按套路出牌，一路扮豬吃虎，將人設拗成了病嬌之態，憑藉一己之力手撕名媛圈，更讓太子和金珀皇子拜倒在石榴裙下，硬生生將奪嫡加權謀的大戲劇本改成了一出人間沙雕甜愛劇.

programme.title: 以美之名
programme.desc: 師出同門的整形外科醫生喬楊和周靜雯是多年冤家，兩個女人在各自最糗的時刻迎來宿命般重逢，同為整形醫院的王牌醫生，二人帶領各自團隊，展開關於美、關於女性職場、關於醫者仁心的激烈探討與衝撞。直到更大的敵人出現，兩人克服對彼此的偏見聯手，與極度危險的黑醫美勢力對抗，找回屬於醫生的高光、亦成就更美的自己.

programme.desc: 大唐，玄武門之變後，太子李建成及其黨羽被誅。其女李長歌(迪麗熱巴)憑高超武藝逃出宮，並在追捕過程中制造「墮崖假死」而逃生，女扮男裝隱瞞身份流落民間，一心伺機誅殺李世民為父母復仇。在與突厥特勒阿史那隼(吳磊)一役中，長歌為保朔州百姓而與阿史那隼談判，自願為虜。在被阿史那隼帶往突厥後，長歌用智慧和謀略為阿史那隼解決部落紛爭，從奴隸變為幕僚。在和阿史那隼的相處過程中，長歌被這個勇猛無匹、重情重義的異族青年所吸引，兩人傾心相戀，譜寫了一曲跨越民族和文化的愛情戀歌.(c)

programme.title: 花琉璃軼聞
programme.desc: 大晉昌隆年間，剛剛大勝金珀國立下赫赫戰功的護國大將軍花應庭，將掌上明珠唯一的女兒花琉璃先送返京城。自小隨父兄在邊關軍營長大的花琉璃雖是女兒身，但天資聰穎，更習得一身好武藝。然而京城不同於邊關，一方面，花家擁兵自重的謠言甚囂塵上，另一方面，二皇子姬元溯以非長子身份被冊封為太子，又偏不務正業，本已引人側目。本以為走入了風暴眼的花琉璃，卻完全不按套路出牌，一路扮豬吃虎，將人設拗成了病嬌之態，憑藉一己之力手撕名媛圈，更讓太子和金珀皇子拜倒在石榴裙下，硬生生將奪嫡加權謀的大戲劇本改成了一出人間沙雕甜愛劇.(n)

programme.title: 以美之名
programme.desc: 師出同門的整形外科醫生喬楊和周靜雯是多年冤家，兩個女人在各自最糗的時刻迎來宿命般重逢，同為整形醫院的王牌醫生，二人帶領各自團隊，展開關於美、關於女性職場、關於醫者仁心的激烈探討與衝撞。直到更大的敵人出現，兩人克服對彼此的偏見聯手，與極度危險的黑醫美勢力對抗，找回屬於醫生的高光、亦成就更美的自己.(n)

programme.desc: 大唐，玄武門之變後，太子李建成及其黨羽被誅。其女李長歌(迪麗熱巴)憑高超武藝逃出宮，並在追捕過程中制造「墮崖假死」而逃生，女扮男裝隱瞞身份流落民間，一心伺機誅殺李世民為父母復仇。在與突厥特勒阿史那隼(吳磊)一役中，長歌為保朔州百姓而與阿史那隼談判，自願為虜。在被阿史那隼帶往突厥後，長歌用智慧和謀略為阿史那隼解決部落紛爭，從奴隸變為幕僚。在和阿史那隼的相處過程中，長歌被這個勇猛無匹、重情重義的異族青年所吸引，兩人傾心相戀，譜寫了一曲跨越民族和文化的愛情戀歌.(n)

programme.title: 念無雙
programme.desc: 故事改編自十四郎的小說《天下無雙》，講述了為取回神界的寶物，神女無雙下凡刺殺有狐族大祭司源仲，但無雙發現事情另有隱情，在調查的過程中兩人相愛，並攜手拯救了世界的故事.(n)

programme.title: 花琉璃軼聞
programme.desc: 大晉昌隆年間，剛剛大勝金珀國立下赫赫戰功的護國大將軍花應庭，將掌上明珠唯一的女兒花琉璃先送返京城。自小隨父兄在邊關軍營長大的花琉璃雖是女兒身，但天資聰穎，更習得一身好武藝。然而京城不同於邊關，一方面，花家擁兵自重的謠言甚囂塵上，另一方面，二皇子姬元溯以非長子身份被冊封為太子，又偏不務正業，本已引人側目。本以為走入了風暴眼的花琉璃，卻完全不按套路出牌，一路扮豬吃虎，將人設拗成了病嬌之態，憑藉一己之力手撕名媛圈，更讓太子和金珀皇子拜倒在石榴裙下，硬生生將奪嫡加權謀的大戲劇本改成了一出人間沙雕甜愛劇.(n)

programme.title: 才不要和老闆談戀愛
programme.desc: 《才不要和老闆談戀愛》改編自葉斐然的同名小説，講述了陸詢的員工錢唯在28歲事業受阻時陰差陽錯回到18歲，重新遇上老闆，從職場跨越到校園，再重新迴歸職場，一路高歌猛進，追求事業愛情雙豐收的成長故事.(n)

programme.desc: 大晉昌隆年間，剛剛大勝金珀國立下赫赫戰功的護國大將軍花應庭，將掌上明珠唯一的女兒花琉璃先送返京城。自小隨父兄在邊關軍營長大的花琉璃雖是女兒身，但天資聰穎，更習得一身好武藝。然而京城不同於邊關，一方面，花家擁兵自重的謠言甚囂塵上，另一方面，二皇子姬元溯以非長子身份被冊封為太子，又偏不務正業，本已引人側目。本以為走入了風暴眼的花琉璃，卻完全不按套路出牌，一路扮豬吃虎，將人設拗成了病嬌之態，憑藉一己之力手撕名媛圈，更讓太子和金珀皇子拜倒在石榴裙下，硬生生將奪嫡加權謀的大戲劇本改成了一出人間沙雕甜愛劇.(n)

programme.title: 念無雙
programme.desc: 故事改編自十四郎的小說《天下無雙》，講述了為取回神界的寶物，神女無雙下凡刺殺有狐族大祭司源仲，但無雙發現事情另有隱情，在調查的過程中兩人相愛，並攜手拯救了世界的故事.(n)

programme.title: 才不要和老闆談戀愛
programme.desc: 《才不要和老闆談戀愛》改編自葉斐然的同名小説，講述了陸詢的員工錢唯在28歲事業受阻時陰差陽錯回到18歲，重新遇上老闆，從職場跨越到校園，再重新迴歸職場，一路高歌猛進，追求事業愛情雙豐收的成長故事.(n)

programme.desc: 突破傳統音樂綜藝節目模式，創新性地將舞台設立在郵輪上，從中國上海啟航，途經沖繩、越南、新加坡、馬來西亞，最終抵達香港；吸納數百名來自亞洲各國的00後新銳唱將，他們將在Jessie J、張靚穎、張信哲、尤長靖所組成的「新聲團」，及近百位亞洲各國音樂人的見證下，開啟一次巡迴亞洲的音樂競演.

programme.title: 我們的歌 第五季
programme.sub-title: 三代歌手盲配開啟潮音之戰
programme.desc: 在音樂主題上再度突破，以「一路為伍，向生綻放」為主題，甄選了貼近生活的歌曲和作品，用歌聲傳遞正能量；邀請了A-Lin、大張偉、庾澄慶、馬嘉祺、光良、蘇慧玲、任賢齊、陳卓璇、曾比特、白舉綱、吳莫愁等老、中、青三代歌手，在全新升級的「盲選配對」模式中組合獻唱，在代際傳承、時代交融中突破自我，打造一場最溫暖、最動人的音樂盛宴.

programme.title: 美好生活荔枝幫

programme.title: 開始跳舞吧 第2季

programme.desc: In 2029, South Korea's lunar exploration spacecraft Woori-ho embarks on a journey towards the Moon. The whole world pays attention to this great challenge, but a solar flare erupts, causing a solar wind to engulf the spacecraft, leaving only the crew member Hwang Sun-woo stranded alone. This is not the first time that South Korea's spacecraft has headed to the Moon. Five years ago, the Narae-ho soared into the sky with grand dreams, only to blow up into pieces upon launch. Now, in the face of another tragedy, the only survivor, Sun-woo, becomes the focus of the efforts of the Korea Aerospace Research Institute and the government. The entire nation hopes for his safe return. To ensure Sun-woo's rescue, the former flight director, Kim Jae-gook, who had been researching deep in the mountains, takes responsibility for the Narae-ho accident five years ago and rejoins the mission. However, his efforts alone are not enough. In search of another hope to rescue Sun-woo, Kim seeks the.

programme.title: 長津湖
programme.desc: The story takes place in winter, 1950. In the freezing cold Changjin Lake region, a bloody battle between the United States and China begins. Faced with the harshest conditions of extreme cold, lack of rations and vast difference in weaponry, the Chinese troops forge ahead, fearless and determined. They successfully blow up the Shuimen Bridge, making the most critical victory in the War to Resist U.S. Aggression and Aid Korea.

programme.title: 低一點的天空
programme.desc: Fat Cat, a nickname because of his chubby body, is a moderately mentally handicapped person. He works happily and passionately as a delivery boy in a restaurant. Little Cheung is a spastic with normal IQ working as an office boy. Fairy Snow White, name it after a renowned Chinese opera actress, is a blissful, middle-class daughter. Her bright future suddenly turned vague when she became blind at age twelve. From then on, she is living in the dark, but her childhood memories enable her to live in peace and harmony. Fat Cat, Little Cheung and Snow White become good friends afterwards, sharing their respective dream. They don't think it is feasible except Fat Cat does..

programme.title: 消失的兇手
programme.desc: A women's prison in the Northern China in 1932, Prisoner FU Yuan (JIANG Yiyan) digs a tunnel in her prison cell with a silver spoon and escapes. Inspector SONG Donglu (LAU Ching-wan) is summoned to investigate FU's escape. By tracking down the letters sent to him by FU, it sets SONG off to Hong City to unravel FU's disappearance.

programme.title: 小心陷井
programme.desc: Shunsuke Kawamura worked in a real estate company and was always the best of the best when it came to sales. He was going to marry the daughter of the CEO of his company, but then, something unexpected happened...Just before the day of his wedding, he attended a surprise party held by his colleagues and got drunk. On his way home, he accidentally fell into a deep manhole. By the time he woke up, it was already midnight. What was even worse was that his right leg was heavily injured and he could neither contact the police nor find out his current location using GPS. The only person he could contact was his ex-girlfriend, but she did not believe in his words. He started to believe that he might have been set up by someone, so he decided to set up a new Twitter account named “Manhole Girl”, hoping that with the help of the internet, he could locate himself and call out for help. Netizens excitedly assisted him to search for the suspect.

programme.title: 爆谷電影現場
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: 愛慾難分: 原諒他77次
programme.desc: When Adam and Eva break up after ten years, Adam thinks the breach was caused by one trivial incident, but Eva knows she's already forgiven Adam 77 times! Sweethearts since law school, Adam changed professions to start a Thai boxing studio and gradually became indifferent to Eva. Seemingly petty matters, like forgetting she hates raisin cookies, become the catalyst for her moving out and changing her Facebook status to 'single'. Despondent, Adam has a drunken tryst with his student, Mandy. Adam gains new insight after accidentally discovering Eva's private journal. Entitled '77 Heartbreaks', the title refers to the philosophy that 'forgiving someone 7 times isn't enough; 70 x 7 times is too much; so go ahead and forgive 77 times!' Reading it makes Adam realize his love. But what can he do to win her back? And what secret is contained in the journal's torn-out last page? He rushes to Eva and melts her heart by recounting their happy memories. When Eva tells him Heartbreak #77.

programme.title: 片場職人 -黃修平
programme.desc: Director Adam Wong's films consistently explore themes of growth and self-discovery through the lens of youth. This episode of 'Movie Craftsmen' features Adam, who discusses his filmmaking journey and tells how his creative mindset has evolved from a relentless drive to true-to-life spirit. He also takes ' The Way We Talk' as an example to depict the crucial role of music and sound effects play in film. As both a film director and university lecturer, he also shares the significance of his commitment to filmmaking.

programme.title: 失戀急讓
programme.desc: Lung is facing a serious situation in life. His girlfriend won't marry him unless he can buy her a 1000-sq ft apartment in one year's time..

programme.title: 一個人的武林
programme.desc: A vicious killer Feng is going round Hong Kong killing top martial arts exponents, leaving a secret weapon called the Moonshadow as his calling card. When convicted killer and kung fu expert, Xia, hears of this, he offers to help the police catch the killer, in return for his freedom. Despite their misgivings, the police release the former police martial arts instructor into their custody. With his help, they realize from the chronological order of the victims that the killer is targeting his victims, all the top masters in their martial arts style, following a martial code of training. When Xia also disappears after a close encounter with Feng, they suspect the worse..

programme.title: 北京遇上西雅圖之不二情書
programme.desc: Jiao Ye moved to Macau with her father when she was 15. She is a sassy casino worker who longs for love, but her life was hard. Daniel, a commitment-averse real estate agent in Los Angeles who specializes in selling properties to wealthy Chinese and father of a teenage son. Love blooms between the two as they start exchanging letters because of a book, they sharing their most personal and intimate self with each other.

programme.title: 猶瑟與虎魚們
programme.desc: A fateful encounter between average college student Tsuneo and a wheelchair-bound dreamer, Josee, who spends her time reading and painting. As Tsuneo is swept up by her dreams, Josee takes another chance at facing reality.

programme.title: 逆向誘拐
programme.desc: Siu-yu, a financial analyst who has been working to complete a budget analyst for an investment bank, finds that a file containing confidential information has been mysteriously deleted. Soon after, her boss, John, receives a ransom email from someone called K Kidnapper, demanding just $190,000 worth of ransom. The ransom must be paid in 3 days, otherwise they will share the information to public. Under a detective's secret investigation, everyone could be the suspect..

programme.title: 孩子轉運站
programme.desc: 'Sanghyeon' is always struggling from debt, and 'Dongsu' works at a baby box facility. On a rainy night, they steal the baby 'Woosung,' who was left in the baby box, to sell him at a good price. Meanwhile, detectives were watching, and they quietly track them down to capture the crucial evidence.

programme.title: 非常幸運
programme.desc: Going nowhere in love and stuck in life as a lowly travel agent, Sophie finds escape in her own comic book creations. When she was winning the office contest for a prize trip to Singapore suddenly turns her life upside in the best way possible, as she meets there the man of her dreams: David, the handsome super-spy from her own comics. Before she can even get pack her luggage together, off they jump from the Marina Bay Sands Skydeck, and the chase is on for a lip-shaped key to the billion-dollar diamond called “Lucky Star Diamond”, a diamond capable of destroying the world, one country at a time.

programme.title: 絕世好賓
programme.desc: A man is hired to look after a spoiled rich girl, but is then pulled into a scheme meant to re-evaluate her life.

programme.title: 末日廝殺橋
programme.desc: Due to sudden deteriorating weather conditions, visibility on the Airport Bridge is severely impaired, leaving people stranded and at risk of the bridge collapsing due to a series of chain collisions and explosions. Amidst the chaos, the canine subjects 'Echo' from the military experiment 'Project Silence,' who were being transported in secret, break free, and all human survivors become targets of relentless attacks. Various individuals find themselves stranded on the Airport Bridge for different reasons - a government official from the presidential office who was seeing off his daughter at the airport; a tow truck driver who was on his way to a multi-collision scene; an elderly who were returning from a trip abroad; sisters who missed their flights, and Dr. Yang, the researcher responsible for Project Silence - and a desperate struggle begins for them to escape to safety.

programme.title: 蘋果咬一口
programme.desc: Miss Sung has come to Hong Kong to be a teacher, and hopefully moonlight as a model. On the Internet, she starts to talk with 'Blue Moon', a photographer. While attempting to shoot, the two have an argument, and Sung seems to lose her chance at being a model, until a second consideration by Jet leads to a completed shoot. Love between the two begins to bloom, but Jet's stepsister, who is also one of Miss Sung's students, starts to interfere, and may just ruin everything.

programme.title: 嚦咕嚦咕新年財
programme.desc: Years ago Andy's passion for Mahjong cost his family their entire fortune, his brother Louis then turned against him. Thus now Louis suffers from economy downturn...

programme.title: 殺人預言
programme.desc: One day, the dead body of Min-tae only brother Seok-tae was found, and Seok-tae ‘s wife Moon-young has disappeared. While searching for clues on this brother's death, Min-tae found that a novelist Ho-ryung also following the same trail and he discovered that the death of his brother was predicted in Ho-ryung's bestselling novel, ‘Nocturnal.' Min-tae was thrown into confusion and brother's gang and police also getting involved in the case. To find out the truth behind brother's death, Min-tae began a relentless and furious pursuit..

programme.title: 爆谷製造 -當黑夜遮蔽白晝時
programme.desc: Two murder cases weave a poignant love story over twelve years; as the police investigate further, it's found that everyone was attempting to hide different secrets and making the case totally mystified. In the film ‘As It Burns', Stephy played two roles as Yin Ching and Lam Yam. How does she think about both characters? When playing such role of a scary lover, she has expressed that it turned out to be quite the opposite - even enjoyed of pain pleasure from being so? Let's catch her up about this bewildering case.

programme.title: 愛慾難分: 白晝如焚
programme.desc: An explosion takes place in an apartment late at night, detective Ngai Wan arrives for the investigation and a charred woman body found on spot, her name is Yin Ching. Ching is getting married with Ng Lam who grew up in a wealthy family. Though it seems to be an accident, Wan feels that something is unusual. Wan first investigate the background of Ching and finds that her mother was died in a fire accident fifteen years ago also. Before that, Ching and her mother were in a difficult relationship, Lo Chi Fung was the only person Ching could talk to. They both grew up in Pak Sin Town and disappeared together after the accident happened. Wan perseveres in the investigation but the case just like falling into the mist as everyone related to Ching are all hiding some secrets. The turning point comes out until Lo Chi Fung and his girlfriend Lam Yam show up. The two fatal cases are crossing fifteen years, everyone can be suspected. The truth is far beyond everyone's imagination behi.

programme.title: 爆谷電影現場
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: 臨時劫案
programme.desc: Two perplexed middle-aged losers, Robby and Fai are good friends. Fai is honest man. His wife left him with an elderly home business. Fai has tried very hard to keep it running until the owner increases the rent crustily. Taxi driver Robby, who is timid and unreliable, he always neglected the conflicts between his mother and his wife. Robby always lives paycheck to paycheck without a financial plan, so he is at a loss what to do. There are two robberies involving the money exchange stores just across the street encourages Robby and Fai to get a gun and rob the same. It is a destiny to meet the ruthless bandit Mui, who acts wicked, scheming and chivalrous.

programme.title: 攻殼機動隊
programme.desc: In the year 2029, advances in cybernetic technology allowed people to replace body parts and organs for robotic ones. Even the brain could be replaced with a cyber-brain with the ability to gain access to the internet and different networks. Major Motoko Kusanagi, a cyborg agent working for the government, and her team have been given the assignment to track down the notorious hacker known as ‘The Puppetmaster' and uncover his plans. Her mission explores the escalating synergy between humanity and technology, while questioning the very essence of sentient existence.

programme.title: 新宿事件
programme.desc: The foreign migrant communities in Tokyo live shadowy lives. The Japanese neither acknowledge nor welcome them. They are shunned by the mainstream society, hounded by the yakuza, and go about their days under fear of being discovered and repatriated. It is an alien world for Steelhead – an honest, hardworking tractor repairman. Steelhead had decided to take the perilous journey to Tokyo after he lost contact with his girlfriend, who had arrived in the city earlier.

programme.title: 小心眼
programme.desc: Zhang Liang is a young man who does not engage into any proper work. His secret hobby is to play with all kinds of high-tech candid technology, especially the candid photographs. He likes to upload the photographs on the Internet to share his homepage with others. Within his beloved masterpiece, he specially falls madly in love on a young air-stewardess. One day, Zhang Liang follows the young lady Amy from the airport to Tai O. In order to catch more splendid segments, Liang brings his full equipment all the way to stay in a vacation house - Mei King Village and becomes a neighbour of Amy..

programme.title: 最後的怒放
programme.desc: Forty years after leaving Japan for a boxing career in the U.S. that never panned out, Jin returns to restart his life with his old boxing buddies. When hotheaded young boxer Shogo asks for Jin's help to get him back into the ring after an unfair loss, the two men decide to seize their final chance at glory.

programme.title: 非同凡響
programme.desc: Ms Tsui is a music teacher in a special education needs (SEN) school, who is not able to switch to a mainstream school due to stereotyping and labelling; Zoey is an underachiever from a Band 1 school, who is struggling for the coming public examination; Ka Ho is a rebellious teenager from a Band 3 school, who idles away his time and doesn't care about his handicapped little brother...Fate drives the three to take part in a musical they deem worthless for their own purposes, which turns out to be a journey of self-discovery towards their dreams and goals.

programme.title: 一秒鐘
programme.desc: China during the Cultural Revolution. A prisoner escapes from a labour camp. He risks everything in his search for a stolen film reel in which his long-lost daughter appears – for one second. Soon he encounters the thief, an orphaned girl haunted by her own terrible loss.

programme.title: 聖誕玫瑰
programme.desc: Tim is a defence attorney with a heart of gold. Refusing to be simply a hired gun for his clients, he quits his high-powered job to become a prosecutor for the Justice Department. With the support of fiancee Megan and cop buddy Nam, Tim decides to start afresh. When he meets a handicapped piano teacher, Jing, who urges him to help her. She is accusing her doctor, Zhou a renowned surgeon of sexual harassment during a routine check-up. But with no witnesses and only their own conflicting testimonies, a Rashomon-like mystery unfolds. To make matters worse, Zhou's defence attorney, Freddy, is Tim's successor at his old law firm, and proves to be Tim's toughest opponent to-date. As a media frenzy encircles the case, it slowly destroys the lives of everyone involved.

programme.title: 爆谷巨星匯：舒淇: 游龍戲鳳
programme.desc: It's hardly a coincidence that Sam is considered the most eligible bachelor in town. Not only is he a young, smart, and insightful entrepreneur with a coveted fortune, but he also happens to be a blithe spirit with a carefree attitude to life. However, every success has its price. Sam has already divorced three times and finds himself crawling back to the game of love sooner than he has expected. It is love at first sight when Sam chances upon a feisty, fast-talking woman with the odd name of Milan at a Macau casino. But the catch is, she is a part-time poker dealer and a full-time cabaret dancer, “careers” not exactly congruent with his station in life. Fallen in love against all odds, this mismatched couple soon makes headline in all media which turn Milan into an It girl overnight..

programme.title: 72家租客
programme.desc: Past and present survival of the common man in the big city - ups and downs, laughters and tears... In 1970s Hong Kong, rapacious landlords try to evict 72 tenants but sworn brothers Ha Kugn and Shek Kin help the group of 72 defeat the landlord and landlady and coincidentally rescue Pinky from a planned forced marriage. When both sworn brothers fall for Pinky and propose to her, she flips a coin 'heads or tails' and Ha wins her hand in marriage. The sworn brothers become sworn enemies and Shek's hatred fuels intense rivalry against Ha in business dealings ranging from the manufacture of plastic flowers to the selling of stinky bean curd. Even after 40 years they continue to clash and in 2010 they are in keen competition selling electronics appliances in Sai Yeung Choi Street, Mongkok, the busiest street in the city and still home to the 72 tenants. In fiercely competitive Sai Yeung Choi Street high rents force businessmen to use every means to survive, with electronics shops.

Through their journey back to their original owner, we trace the stories of several fans whose lives were touched and forever changed by their chance encounters with their idol. Stories of: Growing confidence, Inspiration, Courage, Rekindled faith in people, and Friendship. Life may end but love and memorie.(n)

programme.title: 手機見鬼
programme.desc: Lily, a popular YouTuber reeling from her boyfriend's betrayal, discovers a haunted phone belonging to Xiaoya, a bullied high school student who tragically took her own life. As eerie messages and calls pull Lily into Xiaoya's ghost world, she learns of the spirit's desire for revenge against those who hurt her. Empathizing with Xiaoya's pain, Lily begins to understand the quest for justice. However, she soon realizes that helping Xiaoya seek vengeance comes at a steep cost, and some hauntings can never truly be escaped.(n)

programme.title: 片場職人 -黃修平
programme.desc: Director Adam Wong's films consistently explore themes of growth and self-discovery through the lens of youth. This episode of 'Movie Craftsmen' features Adam, who discusses his filmmaking journey and tells how his creative mindset has evolved from a relentless drive to true-to-life spirit. He also takes ' The Way We Talk' as an example to depict the crucial role of music and sound effects play in film. As both a film director and university lecturer, he also shares the significance of his commitment to filmmaking.(n)

programme.title: 爆谷電影現場
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.(n)

programme.title: 青龍影后秀: 閨密盜賞團
programme.desc: In 1970s South Korea, women free divers who have harvested shellfish suffer a threat to their livelihoods after a chemical factory opens in their seaside village. Using their specialty in diving and knowledge of the waters, old friends Choon-ja and Jin-sook start to smuggle goods. However, when they find out they are being set up, they plan for the most mind-bending and dangerous job to seek revenge, which could become their biggest break-or the end of it all.(n)

programme.title: 無雙
programme.desc: Lee Man, a member of a notorious money counterfeiting ring, is arrested in Thailand and extradited back to Hong Kong. Thanks to renowned painter Yuen Man, Lee is offered a deal by the police: Reveal the identity of Painter, the charismatic leader of the counterfeiting ring, and Yuen can bail him out. Lee has no choice but to comply and recount his story. In the 1990s, Lee and Yuen were lovers living together in Vancouver, seeking to be seen in the art world. However, success eludes them, and Lee is forced to go make counterfeit paintings to make a living. Lee's counterfeit paintings catch the eyes of Painter, and he decides to recruits Lee to join his team. Together with Painter's elite team, Lee travels the world in search of technologies to create the “Super Dollar,” a counterfeit bill that circumvents the anti-counterfeiting measures of the 1996 American dollar. But when Lee witnesses Painter's violent methods in action, he becomes desperate to escape his employer's grip.(n)

programme.title: 七月返歸
programme.desc: Heung Wing has been sensitive to paranormal activity and keeps seeing ghosts since he was a kid, which is called having “Yin Yang” eyes. To avoid being excluded by his peer, he was taught to pretend nothing happened, even though he knew their existence. He then left from Hong Kong to Canada because of his miserable childhood. One day, Heung Wing is told that his mother has been in coma by committing suicide, which forces him to return to Hong Kong. When he goes back to the old home, everything looks strange and unfamiliar to him. What's more horrifying is, a series of weird cases happen in the neighbourhood, and ghosts show up in front of him again. The situation is deteriorating beyond his imagination..(n)

programme.title: 風暴
programme.desc: A hardboiled senior police inspector Lui, hot on the trails of a seasoned criminal Nam and his tight crew, determines to put an end to this madness..(n)

programme.title: 告訴世界我來過
programme.desc: The 24-hour veterinary clinic acts like a bridge, witnessing the birth, separation, sickness and death of animals that human ever loved. On the contrary, also filled with our hope and despair. Some of their lives are in danger because of human's selfishness and ruthlessness. 'Once They Were Here ' tells the fate from different animals on the choice of human. Perhaps it is not pure love and random. The so-called equality of life is only reflected in the uninterrupted heartbeat.(n)

programme.title: 葉問3
programme.desc: In the late 1950s, in Hong Kong which is under British colonial rule, Frank, a foreign property developer who colludes with the gangs and even the Police, is reclaiming houses and a school from the local community. It is not a good time for the Wing Chun master Ip Man to deal with young Bruce Lee who just applied for an apprenticeship. For the good of the people, he steps forward and re-enters the “battlefield”. In collaboration with another Wing Chun practitioner Tin Chi, Ip Man rescues the children kidnapped by the gangs..(n)

programme.title: 千機變
programme.desc: Ace Vampire slayer Reeve and his new partner Gipsy are on this mission, however Reeve's younger sister Helen falls in love with the Vampire fifth prince Kazaf.(n)

programme.title: 淪落人
programme.desc: A paralyzed and hopeless man meets his new Filipino domestic helper who has put her dreams on hold to come to Hong Kong to earn a living. These two strangers live under the same roof, and they learn to face the different seasons of life.(n)

programme.title: 長津湖之水門橋
programme.desc: During the second battle of the War to Resist U.S. Aggression and Aid Korea, the 9th Corps Command issues an order for the 7th Infantry Company to attack the Sumun Bridge. The 7th Company suffers a tough march to the Sumun Bridge. The soldiers are near their limits, every step forward in the midst of the harsh weather only means another great challenge to the body and mind..(n)

programme.title: 爆谷電影現場
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.(n)

programme.title: 勿說是推理
programme.desc: One day, a talkative college student with a natural perm, Totonou Kunou visits Hiroshima for an art exhibition, and there meets a teenage girl, Shioji Kariatsumari, who says she is a friend of Garo Inudo. “Would you work for me? Lives and money are at stake. I'm serious.” She offers Totonou a part-time job, which turns out to be related to the succession of an enormous inheritance. Totonou decides to help her out, only to get involved in an inheritance battle of the noble and shady Kariatsumari family, where people have been killed for generations. Multiple dark sides and mysteries of the family are laid out behind the inheritance. What truth is buried there.(n)

programme.title: 爭氣
programme.desc: Oscar-winning documentary filmmaker Ruby Yang's newest film, 'My Voice, My Life' follows an unlikely group of misfit high school students from Hong Kong cast together for a musical theater performance. From low self-esteem to blindness, each student confronts unique personal challenges in the process of developing his or her character.The film is produced by the L plus H Creations Foundation, in association with the Lee Hysan Foundation.(n)

programme.title: 遺愛
programme.desc: Twenty years ago, young mother Elisa was found guilty of manslaughter; twenty years later, her orphaned girl, Daisy, was arrested for drug possession. Tragedy remains trapped in a fateful loop cursing generations to generations of youth..(n)

programme.title: 爆谷電影現場
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.(n)

programme.title: 青龍影后秀: 反詐師奶兵團
programme.desc: The scammer who scammed my money asked for help! Duk-hee, an energetic woman looking into various loans due to a laundry fire, receives a call from a bank clerk named Son offering a reasonable loan. Sending money to Son who demanded various fee for the loan, she later realizes that the entire process was a voice phishing scam, leaving her in shock. Having lost her entire fortune and forced to live on the streets with her children, Duk-hee receives another call from Son one day... This time, it's a plea for help! Determined to rescue the scammer and recover her lost money, Duk-hee equips herself with various skills and, along with her colleagues, who are equally determined, to take matters into her own hands.(n)

programme.title: 皇家女將
programme.desc: One by one, the Huangs died in the course of safeguarding law and order in Hong Kong. First, the father and then the two elder sons gave their lives in action. That leaves Tsung-pao, the youngest son, and four daughters. They are all police officers. What makes the mother prouder is Tsung-pao's marrying a senior policewoman Mina. Old Mrs. Huang is hoping to see a grandson to carry on the lawmen family tree. But the sisters don't like Mina. They make sure she does not have a good time. Mina suffers in silence. A raid on a Vietnamese gang was ordered. Tsung-pao and Mina to command. But sister Ling commits a serious mistake and the whole operation fails. Ling is suspended. She blames it on Mina..

programme.title: 警察故事續集
programme.desc: Receiving a humiliating demotion to traffic duty, Chan decides to take a vacation with girlfriend May. However, when terrorists threaten Hong Kong, he abort his vacation plans..

programme.title: 大冒險家
programme.desc: 20 years ago, in the region of Golden Triangle, Wah(aged about 9) and his parents, his god father (Keung) with his daughter (aged about 5) planned to smuggle some valuable items and information into Thailand. Wah's father, Keung and Leung were the closest of friends, just like blood brothers, all 3 of them were C.I.A. agents. Keung left for Thailand before the others to plan the operation. Leung ganged up with some bandits and forced Wah's father to surrender the confidential information. Wah, hidden in the dark, saw his parents being killed. 20 years later, Wah became an officer in the Thai Air Force. He couldn't take his mind off the revenge. Leung became a successful business man. He was in Thailand to launch a major business project. Ignoring Keung's advise, Wah and Roy slipped into Leung's hotel to try to assassinate him..

programme.title: 標錯參
programme.desc: Sammo and Kenny are lowly employees of a jewelry shop. Sammo too often is the target of abuse from the manageress. One day the two are sent to show the diamonds to a sheik. They are robbed on their way to the bank. One by one they are being accused to be in collusion with the robbers. That makes Sammo very angry. To get even, he plans to kidnap the manageress. Kenny somehow learns of the plot. Sammo gets the wrong woman, Joel. Before he can say ABC, Kenny comes along and kidnaps Joel from Sammo. Sammo demands a ransom from the shop. Kenny asks Sammo for a ransom. Both of them come up with nothing, of course. Not exactly nothing because when they go back to work, they find Joel has taken over the shop. And she apparently thinks kindly of her kidnapper Sammo..

programme.title: 新上海灘
programme.desc: The Taiwan military officer, Hsu falls into the enemy's ambush, and floats to the Shanghai shore where he is saved by Ting Lik. Lik teams up with Kueng to try to make a fortune and soon they become famous in Shanghai. The Shanghai tycoon Fung try to eliminate other opponents with the help of Hsu and Lik. Later, Hsu discovers Fung is the mastermind of the ambush that killed all his fellow officials..

programme.title: 富貴逼人
programme.desc: News reporter Bill and his wife live in a public housing flat with their 3 daughters. Their dream is to get rich someday. When Lady Luck comes knocking on their door one day and they win the first prize of the local lottery, Mark Six, all hell break loose..

programme.title: 冒險王
programme.desc: “The Scripture With No Words” had been lost for a long time. Everybody was eager to find it, even the ambitious Japanese. Dr. Wai was antiquarian. Having seen the mysterious “Wooden Horse”, lost control and killing people, he quit his job. However, being supported by his friend, Dr. Wai recovered and resumed to his work. He went to Shanghai trying to locate “The Scripture With No Words” and he discovered that it was in the possession of the leader of “Gang of Salt”. And the game begin..

programme.title: 師姐好狠勁: 皇家師姐
programme.desc: Senior Police Inspector Ng is assigned to work with another lady inspector from Scotland Yard, to investigate the murder of an agent from the Commercial Crime Bureau of London, who was killed because of the evidence he has collected against a crime syndicate in Hong Kong. As the duo try to work around each other's polarized cultures and background, they kick and punch their way through the investigation, leading to 2 small time pickpockets Strepsil and Panadol, who had stolen the passport containing the evidence from the agent before he died. As the bumbling pickpockets try to dodge the assassins in hot pursuit, they eventually turn to the lady cops for help against the crime boss..

programme.title: 五虎將之決裂
programme.desc: 5 CID members are good friends and form a cooperative team in difficult cases. But the 'Five Tigers' gets blackmailed by the villain and questioned by ICAC for the missing money..

programme.title: 追鬼七雄
programme.desc: Long ago in China, corpses are supposed to be able to follow orders given by a leader and 'jump' to their respective burial places. However, some drug dealers use this method to smuggle opium. Things are going well until the local aristocrat, Master Miu, murders a singer's husband as he fails in attempting to rape her. He asks the corpse leader to take the body away. Then, one of the members from drug dealers is killed mysteriously. When the drug dealers try to go after the case, they find a strange corpse sucking in a huge snake in an old tower. Many members are killed as they try to get out in time..

programme.title: 刀劍笑
programme.desc: The Three Swordsmen is a non-stop action-thriller set in ancient China, starring Brigitte Lin Ching Hsia and Andy Lau.

programme.title: 警察故事續集
programme.desc: Receiving a humiliating demotion to traffic duty, Chan decides to take a vacation with girlfriend May. However, when terrorists threaten Hong Kong, he abort his vacation plans..

programme.title: 重案組
programme.desc: Eddie Chan, a guilt-ridden cop trying to silence his demons from a recent shoot-out who is assigned to rescue kidnapped businessman Huang Yifei. It is a trail that leads Chan and his partner, Hung from Hong Kong to Taipei and back to Hong Kong. As the trail gets warmer, Chan begins to suspect that there are internal forces – including Hung – who seem to working against him..

programme.title: 皇家師姐
programme.desc: Senior Police Inspector Ng is assigned to work with another lady inspector from Scotland Yard, to investigate the murder of an agent from the Commercial Crime Bureau of London, who was killed because of the evidence he has collected against a crime syndicate in Hong Kong. programme.title: A 計劃續集
programme.desc: A group of Chinese revolutionaries are being bunted by agents of the Dowager Empress, and Jackie has to use all his courage, wits and physical prowess to keep the peace..

programme.title: 逃學英雄傳
programme.desc: Police Commandant Wong orders officer Ken to go under cover as a schools teacher. Ken's assignment: to stop the infiltration by Taiwan's underworld. Ken is chosen not on his merit. In fact, he is a coward by nature and a bungler of things by choice. But luck seems to be with him. Just handcuffs on Ball, the notorious Mad Killer. Ken's girl friend Hing has jilted him. Once in school, Ken falls madly in love with the sexy teacher Moon. The students, however, make fun of him. Among his tormentors, student leader Ace stands out. But Hing is also assigned to the school as an undercover student. Very soon, she commands the awe and obedience of all girl students. So, when she is told to locate and protect Doggie, the son of a Taiwan gang leader, she and the girls start to strip all boys off their pants to see if they have a certain birthmark on their behind. The reason: this is the only way to identify Doggie..

programme.title: 奇謀妙計五福星
programme.desc: The five met in prison, Teapot, Exhaust Pipe, Vaseline, Curly Jack and Larry became friends and they would stay clean from now on. In fact they formed a cleaning company and worked hard at it after their release. Little did they realize they were released together with Boss Chan of the feared underworld who immediately reactivated his money counterfeit operation..

programme.title: 芭啦芭啦櫻之花
programme.desc: Phillip Wong, a colour-blind dance instructor who is devoted to the Japanese Para Para. He meets Yee, a spoiled rich girl and an attraction begins to form between the two..

programme.title: 靈幻先生
programme.desc: One dark night, a charlatan Uncle Ming attempts to exorcise angry spirits in a haunted house but is unsuccessful and he narrowly escapes. He brings his two ghostly companions Ta Pao and Hsi Pao with him to a nearby town. The town is under attack by a group of bandits with supernatural powers. The thugs are led by Devil Lady, a powerful evil witch doctor. When Ming and the Paos are having dinner in a restaurant, Captain Chiang comes to harass them, and the Paos take revenge by playing tricks on Chiang. Just then, Chiang's master, Uncle Nine, appears and he subdues the two ghosts and traps them inside a wine jar. Ming pleads with Nine to release the Paos. Nine agrees to set the ghosts free but warns Ming that he must part ways with them, but Ta Pao is captured by Devil Lady later due to Chiang's act of mischief..

programme.title: 師姐好狠勁: 皇家戰士
programme.desc: When a Hong Kong policewoman, a Japanese Interpol agent and an air security officer botch a plane hijacking attempt by a militia fanatic, his veteran friends vow revenge. In order to stop the terrorist attacks and also to save their own lives, the three heroes must team up once again to fight their gun-toting adversaries.

programme.title: 沙灘仔與周師奶
programme.desc: Beach Boy and Mrs. Chow have been partners in the police force for years. While investigating a special case, Beach Boy met Ah Yuk whose step-father was one of the crime members. Ah Yuk was alone in Hong Kong and Beach Boy first pitied her, then later fell in love with her. Beach Boy's superior, Inspector Lee Nam who appears to be honest is actually one of the Taiwanese group. He set up Beach Boy and Mrs. Chow. He also courted Ah Yuk..

programme.title: 笑傲江湖
programme.desc: The Sunflower Manuscript that contains martial arts secrets is stolen from the Forbidden City. Head eunuch, Koo Kam-fook, suspects Lam Chun-nam of the theft, so he sends officer Chuen and his men to the Lam dyeing factory to investigate and kill Lam and his son, Ping-chi. Before Lam dies, he whispers to Ling Wu-chung and his schoolmate Ngok Ling-shan where he has hidden the manuscript, so that Chung can tell his son, who is not at the factory. Chung and Shan begin their trip to return to Mount Wah and meet Kwan, who is Chung's master and Shan's father. However, Chuen has already killed Chi and assumed his identity..

programme.title: 漫畫奇俠
programme.desc: Chu Tai Lek and Chu Hau Yee meet Ching Dynasty General-Wong Chiang who had injured and lost his memory when Chus'in wild BBQ. After they knew the general's experience, they help him to find the princess who saved by a man worked in TV Station. Chu Tai Lek thought that the general escaped from Mainland and got a plenty of gold. Wong Chiang and princess found each other and met again at last. But they were come from 200 century, their blood didn't flesh and they could get thousand century jewellery and swords to make survive. So they back to the hole and met the monster of cruelty. The pitched battle started by two groups.

programme.title: 咖喱辣椒
programme.desc: Two cops--both best friends and partners--both become the subject of a beautiful news reporter's documentary. The two soon find themselves competing for screen time as well as the love of the reporter while after a murderous arms dealer.

programme.title: 飛龍猛將
programme.desc: Hotshot lawyer is hired by a mysterious chemistry factory to dig up dirt on an inconvenient fishery seeking damaging court action. Sidekick Hung and professional crook Yuen swiftly sprint to Chan's aid. Ironically the gang finds their toughness softening in the face of two gorgeous ladies at the fishery. They inadvertently hit a center nerve of the chemical factory when they unmask the hideous facade of a narcotic syndicate.

programme.title: 皇家戰士
programme.desc: When a Hong Kong policewoman, a Japanese Interpol agent and an air security officer botch a plane hijacking attempt by a militia fanatic, his veteran friends vow revenge. In order to stop the terrorist attacks and also to save their own lives, the three heroes must team up once again to fight their gun-toting adversaries.

programme.title: 影人映語 -中產喜劇大師—陳慶嘉
programme.desc: Since the 1980's, Chan Hing Kai has created numerous love comedies, yet he opened up that he was “forced” to write them at that time. Later on, he wrote and co-directed “La Brassiere”, a film which entertains without being obscene. He reveals that one of the leading actor, Lau Ching Wan, complained to him afterwards... In this episode, Hing Kai is invited to share the untold stories from his writing career and talk about the changing ecology of screenwriting in the film industry.

programme.title: 龍跨四海
programme.desc: SHIKO is brought up in a Japanese underworld family but lives with her mother in England after her parents' separation while her elder brother TARO stays with her father BUTA. In a business trip to Paris, SHIKO meets a Chinese illegal immigrant CHIN-SHUI who can only earn his living by working for the Chinatown triads. The stepping in of SHIKO brings a tremendous change to his life. After the assassination for the triads in Paris, CHIN-SHUI flees to England and stays with his Chinese friend, FA-CHIN, who always loves SHIKO. Both SHIKO and CHIN-SHUI fall in love. The company that SHIKO works for is owned by her father BUTA. Both BUTA and TARO discovers NAKAMURI's corrupt practices in their company..

programme.title: 霹靂先鋒
programme.desc: Cheung Tit-hong has recorded numerous meritorious deeds, but he is by nature uncontrollable and antagonistic to his bureaucratic superiors. Before reporting his work to his superiors, he has already successfully arrested the gangsters who steal motorbikes. He also saved an innocent teacher from being wrongly accused of theft by recognizing a female pickpocket. Finally, he has subdued fierce armed robbers in the gambling casino by flexibly utilizing a car thief, Boy. The contradictions in working style between Cheung and his superiors naturally lead to numerous scenes of strong conflicts..

programme.title: 龍在江湖
programme.desc: Brandon Ma, a regular guy working in Hong Kong, who is set up by his drug-dealing best friend Michael, to take the rap for the murder of an undercover cop. Michael also has eyes for Brandon's girl, May. While Brandon languishes in jail, May gives birth to their child and flees to Brazil to avoid the lurid clutches of Michael, who has become a big crime boss. Brandon gets out of prison after eight years, learns the truth, and goes after Michael for revenge..

programme.title: 快餐車
programme.desc: Thomas and David are two quick-witted vendors hawking Chinese fast food from their truck in the busy squares of Barcelona. Their acquaintance with beautiful pickpocket, Sylvia, brings them in contact with novice detective Moby, who is trying to track her whereabouts. Sylvia is actually a wealthy heiress kidnapped by the evil count, who is trying to siphon off her inheritance. The trio puts a spanner in the count's plans, and rescue Sylvia..

programme.title: 鹿鼎記II
programme.desc: Showboy, the good-for-nothing tramp who becomes the emperor's friend, continues his gambling, whoring ways. Little does he realize that enormous forces are aligned against him..

programme.title: 星影週末笑聲匯: 老夫子2001
programme.desc: Master Q and Potato fail the job interview in a school, they then go to find Wong for revenge. But Wong has already retired, so he gives Master Q a secret pouch. Fung is a CID. He is in love with Miss Cheung. But Cheung's mother, the District Councilor, is against it. Uncle Kam believes in some crooks that Fung is going to be the head of the police force in the future. Kam wants to bribe him under his wing for business in the future..

programme.title: 師姐好狠勁: 雌雄大盜
programme.desc: An armed couple breaks in the venue of the world-renowned jewelry designer Yamamoto's exhibition in Tokyo and takes away the most valuable pieces on display. The robbery ends in bloodshed. Inspector Fujioka's assistant is shot to death at the crime scene. The couple takes the jewelry to Hong Kong and Fujioka follows their trail. Madam Yang of the Hong Kong Police is assigned to help him. However, Yang's superior and uncle intervenes the investigation. Fujioka is tired of such power struggle and decides to act on his own accord..

programme.title: 人嚇人
programme.desc: Fatboy is a helper to Grand Uncle who is the town's high priest. They are now found in the ancestral shrine of the Mas working wonders. Fatboy is also being reprimanded by Grand Uncle for being rude to his fiancee, Yuen. The last of the Mas, the rich family in town, is back but Ma Lucho is coming home dead. Accompanying the body is a woman who claims to be Ma's wife and very much pregnant. But Fatboy knows his boyhood friend Ma couldn't be a husband because he was impotent..

programme.title: 八仙飯店之人肉叉燒包
programme.desc: In August 1985, a mutilated corpse is found on the beach of Macao. A police investigation uncovers the mysterious disappearance of the entire family of the Eight Immortals Restaurant. Based on a shocking and horrifying true story.

While Brandon languishes in jail, May gives birth to their child and flees to Brazil to avoid the lurid clutches of Michael, who has become a big crime boss. Brandon gets out of prison after eight years, learns the truth, and goes after Michael for revenge..

programme.title: 猛鬼佛跳牆
programme.desc: It is a dream come true for engineer Bill Cheung when a quiet villa in the countryside is assigned to him as staff quarters. As soon as he moves into this extravagant estate with his wife and 2 daughters, strange things begin to happen. When his daughter Jane discovers the previous owners were burned to death many years ago, Bill's family is already on their way to a similar tragic demise..

programme.title: 雌雄大盜
programme.desc: An armed couple breaks in the venue of the world-renowned jewelry designer Yamamoto's exhibition in Tokyo and takes away the most valuable pieces on display. The robbery ends in bloodshed. Inspector Fujioka's assistant is shot to death at the crime scene. The couple takes the jewelry to Hong Kong and Fujioka follows their trail. Madam Yang of the Hong Kong Police is assigned to help him. However, Yang's superior and uncle intervenes the investigation. Fujioka is tired of such power struggle and decides to act on his own accord..

programme.title: 女黑俠黃鶯

The two women think that Wong is a rich girl, so they treat her very well and hope for repayment. Ah Ching is in love with Ah Kat, a car-repairing worker. Her mother opposes it. Her mother also bears a great debt because of gambling.

programme.title: 富貴再逼人
programme.desc: After he lost his chance of winning easy money in the original film, Bill became an editor for a newspaper and was sent to Canada for a story. What he thought was a chance to re-launch his career turned out to be a reason to get him fired. Just when the family has settled back down in Hong Kong, Bill's wife realized she has won the lottery in Canada..

programme.title: 五個寂寞的心
programme.desc: This is a story about five sixteen years old girls...Yan, Celia, Maggie, Jacky and Kitty are five close friends, they live and study together. During their growing process, all of them have their own confusion. Yan meets Wai accidentally and being love with each other. Kitty is unhappy with her brother's new girlfriend, she wants to separate them then cause many incidents..

programme.title: 秋天的童話
programme.desc: Lee Kay goes to college in New York City and also to visit her boyfriend Dickson. The one to meet her at the airport is a distant relative Boat Head..

programme.title: 夜瘋狂
programme.desc: Teacher Wang is being held hostage one night by a bank robber in an all-night shop. Shop attendant Ling-ling and Wang struggle with the badly wounded robber, who dies in the fight. With two more accomplices, the four girls decide to destroy the body and split the $40 million the man has on him. But his gangs catch up with the girls and are about to rape and then kill them..

After one is captured by the Ninja-gang protecting the rogue cop, the other one gets his old Orphanage gang, dubbed the 'Five Lucky Stars,' to help him. They don't like this much, but they do it..

programme.title: 爆谷星影好戲：師姐好狠勁: 皇家師姐IV之直擊証人
programme.desc: A detective of the Anti-Narcotics Bureau is pursued for a film he snapped containing evidence of drug-trafficking between a CIA and Hong Kong drug traffickers. Before death, he hands the film over to a Hong Kong immigrant, a pier coolie Luk, who throws it away when the killer arrives. Hong Kong police Madam Yeung assigned to help the local police to investigate the case witnesses Luk killing a killer of the Intelligence Agency but concludes that he is innocent and did it out of defense only. Local detective Donnie and his sidekick Michael Wong are responsible for probing the murder, and when Luk escapes to Hong Kong, Donnie and Yeung immediately to Hong Kong to trace him. Donnie and Michael are also under orders to have him arrested and extradited to the USA. However, Luk and Michael have already been and abducted by the crafty killer..

programme.title: 縱橫四海
programme.desc: A trio of art burglars Joe, Jim & Cherie were orphans raised by Mr Chow and trained into pretty thieves. But they advanced to the big time as paintings proved to be most lucrative..

programme.title: 每天嚇你八小時
programme.desc: 'Ghost Invasion'- Tung, who has a simple and pure mind and just started his new job, is quickly attracted by his cool but sexy boss – Sam. At the same time, he meets with his secondary schoolmate in the company – Mick. Mick always talks about women with Tung, he even sets a goal of ‘counting on Sam'. Later, Tung always meets Sam because of overtime work. Sam always changes the style and image when she comes out from washroom at night, which she turns to be seducing, charming and totally different from the one at daytime...'A Horny Ghost'- The boss of a pornographic films dubbing company is a horny man, he is accidentally killed because of a sexual harassment. However, his colleagues are still being sexually harassed by him even he is a ghost now...'The Queen of Gossip'- Amanda, who is the queen of gossip, is noisy and like to exaggerate everything. Even her friends can never escape from her, any good news of her friends will be violated and changed to a bad news. The stranges.

On the eve of the outbreak of war, Kit's past returns to endanger her, and Mark must risk everything for the one true love of his life..

programme.desc: Antique dealer Kwok roams the countryside with his two assistants searching for rare objects. One day they fall into the cellar of a shrine. There they find three vampires, all rendered harmless by talismans. The mission was to destroy the munitions left over in Vietnam during the Vietnam War. Since it was the top secret mission, Lieutenant Lam could only select Chinese felons from the Federal prison lured by the right of residence and big money to execute the mission. As the irregular troop, they just had informal training before they went to Vietnam. During the mission, they had to pass over mountains and challenge their own wills. They started with no trust to become mutually supportive with one another at the end. However, only few of them were able to come back eventually.

programme.desc: “Always On My Mind” is about self-discovery of a man after being diagnosed with an incurable disease. Michael Hui plays the coward newscaster-turned-opportunistic-moneygrubber..

They want to keep the vase themselves so they must get away from the pursuit of a killer sent by Hung, as well as another two mysterious detectives..

A Taoist Priest and local elder, E-mei, opposed it by referring that the church was haunted. Dominated by his son David, the town mayor townsfolk to vote for it in order to smuggle drugs and exercise black magic..

programme.title: BB30
programme.desc: Bau is a poor lawyer who has never won in litigation. He is a righteous guy but his unstable character brings him under disciplinary investigation, during which he meets a beautiful doctor, Cheng. However, since Cheng often deposes against Bau, misunderstanding and conflict grow between the two. On the other hand, Susan, an aerobic dancing instructor, has a deep passion for Bau for a long time and this makes Mo feel jealous and determine to go against him. As Bau and Mo go together, troubles and laughers are stirred up..

On the other side, Yeung Siu Yau dislikes his daughter as a policewoman. hey care for each other, but they lack for communication. Wai Hong Hong, who is the stepmother of the policewoman Miss Yeung, has planned to kill her husband Yeung Siu Yau. However, she finds that the policewoman is the inheritor. She saves Yeung Siu Yau and transfers the target to the policewoman. She will kill the millionaire after the policewoman died..

programme.title: 雞同鴨講
programme.desc: Michael Hui's classic satire about Chinese food versus the new - in which he plays restaurant owner struggling to survive under the commercial attacks by the modern enterprise..(n)

programme.title: 醉拳III
programme.desc: After the reformation of the government, Yuen Sai Hoi was elected President but he himself proclaimed as king. Yuen believed that on his way of the Crown Ceremony, the Jade ring wearing in his wife Sham Yuk's hand would be a sign of prosperity and stability to the throne, so he sent his servant Yeung Kwun to bring Sham Yuk to the Palace. As surrounded by enemies against the King, it was a tough journey for Yeung Kwun and Sham Yuk, but Yeung was successful in getting the help from Wong Kai Ying, a Kung-fu teacher and his son Wong Fai Hung and also a senior kung-fu fighter to make the journey a safe one. It happened that Wong Fai Hung learned the theme of the “Drunken Boxing” and gradually realized that Yuen Sai Hoi would not be a good King and thus Fai Hung join in the rebellious list to overthrow the kingdom of Yuen. Hiring a taoist priest to get rid of him, Cheung is challenged to spend the night in an old abandoned temple were the priest will use his dark magic to attempt to bring an end to Cheung's life.(n)

programme.desc: Since the 1980's, Chan Hing Kai has created numerous love comedies, yet he opened up that he was “forced” to write them at that time. Later on, he wrote and co-directed “La Brassiere”, a film which entertains without being obscene. He reveals that one of the leading actor, Lau Ching Wan, complained to him afterwards... In this episode, Hing Kai is invited to share the untold stories from his writing career and talk about the changing ecology of screenwriting in the film industry.(n)

Wu's top shooter and fighter help her give the girls some fine tuning such as walking on fire. However, since his father was seriously ill, he had to stay in Nanjing to take care of his family business. This affected their relationship and they cooled down on each other. On the other side, Xu was ashamed of his poor family background and did not reveal his love for Shi Chuizhi. In the end, Shen was urged by his stepmother and married his cousin Shi, Ku was set up by her sister Manlu and her husband Zhu Hongcai. She was raped by Zhu and gave birth to a baby. Ten years later, Shen chanced upon Ku..(n)

programme.title: 百變星君
programme.desc: Sing met Bonnie, a secret lover of a gang and is bombed for revenge. Only his mouth, brain and penis can still function. The doctor proposed the 'Sixty Million Dollar Man' plan..(n)

However, Suk-fun suddenly discovered she had terminal illness..(n)

programme.title: 走進老許記
